        sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()

        report['outcomeUnknown']=bool(report['outcomeUnknown'] or command_unknown

def admitted_wal(guard,binding):
    """Pin the actual public ten-case stdout and its authoritative terminal."""
    need(type(binding) is dict and binding==WAL_BINDING,'exact_actual_registry_wal_binding')
    raw=guard.read(ROOT/'proofs/registry-wal-r1.stdout.public.json',262144)
    authority_raw=guard.read(ROOT/'proofs/registry-wal-r1.authority.public.json',65536)
    need(len(raw)==binding['stdoutBytes'] and sha(raw)==binding['stdoutSha256']
         and len(authority_raw)==binding['authorityBytes']
         and sha(authority_raw)==binding['authoritySha256'],'actual_original_registry_wal_bytes')
    authority=json.loads(authority_raw);proof=json.loads(raw)
    need(type(authority) is dict and authority.get('job_id')==binding['jobId']
         and type(authority.get('exit_code')) is int and authority['exit_code']==0
         and authority.get('state')=='succeeded'
         and all(authority.get(k) is True for k in
             ('output_complete','output_durable','terminal_publication_confirmed'))
         and all(authority.get(k) is False for k in ('timed_out','cancelled','automatic_retry')),
         'successful_authoritative_registry_wal_terminal')
    for stream,size in (('stdout',len(raw)),('stderr',0)):
        need(authority.get('log_bytes',{}).get(stream)=={'seen':size,'stored':size}
             and authority.get('log_errors',{}).get(stream) is None
             and authority.get('log_synced',{}).get(stream) is True
             and authority.get('log_truncated',{}).get(stream) is False,
             'complete_original_registry_wal_log_'+stream)
    need(type(proof) is dict and proof.get('schema')=='heptabao.mac-owned-registry-wal-synthetic.r1'
         and proof.get('ok') is True and proof.get('outcomeUnknown') is False
         and proof.get('allCasesMatched') is True and proof.get('allOwnedClosed') is True
         and proof.get('originalDeadlineAfterClosure') is True
         and proof.get('sourceAndRuntimeAfterVerified') is True
         and proof.get('sharedSeconds')==45 and proof.get('querySeconds')==3
         and proof.get('supervisorSeconds')==60 and proof.get('applicationRetries')==0
         and type(proof.get('elapsedSeconds')) in (int,float)
         and math.isfinite(proof['elapsedSeconds']) and 0<=proof['elapsedSeconds']<45
         and all(proof.get(k) is False for k in
             ('productionInputsRead','privateCaptureAuthorized','wholeDatabaseBackupQualified')),
         'successful_complete_public_registry_wal_report')
    wanted=list(binding['cases'])
    need(proof.get('caseIds')==wanted and type(proof.get('cases')) is list
         and [x.get('case') for x in proof['cases']]==wanted,
         'all_ten_exact_registry_wal_cases')
    for row in proof['cases']:
        item=binding['cases'][row['case']];command=row.get('command',{})
        need(row.get('matched') is True and row.get('mainUnchangedAcrossWalCommit') is True
             and row.get('writerClosedBeforeHeldFdClose') is True
             and row.get('readerStdoutBytes')==item['stdoutBytes']
             and row.get('readerStdoutSha256')==item['stdoutSha256']
             and command.get('stdoutBytes')==item['stdoutBytes']
             and command.get('stdoutSha256')==item['stdoutSha256']
             and command.get('controlPipesClosed') is True,'exact_public_registry_wal_case')
    owned=proof.get('ownedCommands',{});volume=owned.get('commands');readers=proof.get('ownedReaders')
    need(owned.get('allOwnedCommandsStopped') is True and owned.get('unknownCommandCount')==0
         and type(volume) is list and len(volume)==1
         and volume[0].get('label')=='owned-wal-volume'
         and volume[0].get('argv')==['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist','/Volumes/T5']
         and type(readers) is list and len(readers)==10
         and [row.get('case') for row in readers]==wanted
         and all(row['command']==reader for row,reader in zip(proof['cases'],readers)),
         'public_registry_wal_one_volume_and_ten_reader_set')
    for row in [*volume,*readers]:
        closed=row.get('cleanup',{})
        need(type(row.get('exitCode')) is int and row['exitCode']==0
             and row.get('completeBeforeDeadline') is True and row.get('outcomeUnknown') is False
             and row.get('streamsClosed') is True and closed.get('ok') is True
             and closed.get('outcomeUnknown') is False and closed.get('directChildReaped') is True
             and closed.get('ownedLiveGroupEmptyBeforeReap') is True
             and closed.get('allGroupRowsEmptyAfterReap') is True
             and closed.get('remainingGroupRows')==[] and closed.get('postReapSignalSent') is False,
             'public_registry_wal_retained_child_closure')
    writers=proof.get('writerConnections');fds=proof.get('ownedFdLedger');held=proof.get('heldT5Final',{})
    need(type(writers) is list and len(writers)==10
         and all(x.get('closeAttempted') is True and x.get('closed') is True
             and x.get('closeErrorType') is None and x.get('cursorsClosed') is True
             and x.get('heldDescriptorsClosed') is True for x in writers)
         and type(fds) is list and fds and all(x.get('closeAttempted') is True
             and x.get('closed') is True for x in fds)
         and held.get('allDescriptorsClosed') is True and held.get('lastAnchorCheckPassed') is True
         and held.get('volumeUUIDVerified') is True and held.get('closeErrors')==[],
         'public_registry_wal_writer_fd_volume_closure')
    pins=proof.get('sourcePins',{})
    need(pins.get('mac_wal_owned_synthetic_r1.py')==binding['controllerSha256']
         and pins.get('mac_registry_readonly_wal_r1.py')==binding['librarySha256']
         and pins.get('mac_guarded_current_capture_r3.py')==CAPTURE_SOURCE_SHA
         and all(pins.get(name)==pin for name,pin in NATIVE_BINDING['modulePins'].items()),
         'actual_registry_wal_source_and_native_pins')
    guard.check()
    return raw,proof

def library_resources_closed(value):
    """Returned-handle/registered-FD evidence, never SQLite internal-FD inference."""
    if type(value) is not dict or value.get('schema')!='heptabao.mac-registry-readonly-wal-attempt.r1':
        return False
    if not all(value.get(key) is True for key in (
        'allOwnedDescriptorsClosed','allHeldDescriptorsClosed','allReturnedConnectionsClosed',
        'allExplicitCursorsClosed','allPublicCodeDescriptorsClosed',
        'publicCodeHashDescriptorsIndividuallyEnumerated')) or value.get('closeErrors')!=[]:
        return False
    for key in ('descriptors','connections','cursors','publicCodeDescriptors'):
        rows=value.get(key)
        if type(rows) is not list or not all(type(row) is dict
            and row.get('closeAttempted') is True and row.get('closed') is True
            and row.get('closeError') is None for row in rows):
            return False
    return True

def capture_envelope(value):
    need(type(value) is dict and value.get('schema')=='heptabao.mac-registry-readonly-wal-attempt.r1'
         and value.get('libraryFailureLedgerAvailable') is True
         and value.get('originalFiveAgentRouteUnchanged') is True
         and value.get('privateResultPublished') is False
         and all(type(value.get(key)) is bool for key in
             ('ok','observationComplete','observationUnknown','originalDeadlineMetAfterClosure')),
         'typed_current_capture_library_envelope')
    need(len(encoded(value))<=196608,'bounded_current_capture_library_envelope')
    if value['ok']:
        need(value['observationComplete'] and not value['observationUnknown']
             and value['originalDeadlineMetAfterClosure'] and value.get('error') is None
             and library_resources_closed(value),'successful_current_capture_library_envelope')
    return value

def kernel_refusals(guard,stage):
    directory=ROOT/'captures'/stage/'probe';main=directory/'writable-owned-main'
    need(guard.read(main,4096)==PROBE_CONTENT,'owned_probe_exact_initial_bytes')
    original=ident(main.lstat());rows=[]
    for path,create in ((main,False),(Path(str(main)+'-wal'),True),(Path(str(main)+'-shm'),True)):
        remaining();refusal=None;opened=None
        with guard.parent(path) as (parent,name):
            if create:
                try:os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
                else:raise Refused('owned_probe_sidecar_preexisting')
            try:
                with critical():
                    flags=os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|(os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL if create else os.O_APPEND)
                    fd=os.open(name,flags,0o600,dir_fd=parent)
                    opened={'fd':fd,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False};fds.append(opened)
            except OSError as error:refusal=error.errno
            finally:
                if opened is not None:need(close_fd(opened),'owned_probe_fd_close')
            need(opened is None and refusal in (errno.EACCES,errno.EPERM),'kernel_owned_write_not_refused')
            if create:
                try:os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)
                except FileNotFoundError:pass
                else:raise Refused('owned_probe_sidecar_created')
        rows.append({'case':'sidecar_create' if create else 'main_write_open',
                     'name':path.name,'denied':True,'errno':refusal})
    need(ident(main.lstat())==original and guard.read(main,4096)==PROBE_CONTENT,
         'owned_probe_no_file_change')
    endpoint=('127.0.0.1',9);sock=None;refusal=None;socket_row=None
    try:
        with critical():
            sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
            socket_row={'socket':sock,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False};sockets.append(socket_row)
        sock.settimeout(min(3.0,remaining()))
        sock.connect(endpoint)
    except OSError as error:refusal=error.errno
    finally:
        if socket_row is not None:
            with critical():
                socket_row['closeAttempted']=True
                try:sock.close();socket_row['closed']=True
                except BaseException as error:socket_row['closeErrorType']=type(error).__name__
    need(refusal in (errno.EACCES,errno.EPERM),'kernel_loopback_connect_not_refused')
    need(socket_row is None or socket_row['closed'],'owned_probe_socket_close')
    rows.append({'case':'loopback_connect','endpoint':'127.0.0.1:9','denied':True,'errno':refusal})
    remaining()
    return {'allFourDenied':True,'onlyOwnedWriteProbes':True,'externalAddressAttempted':False,
            'profileWriteScope':'fresh_capture_output_only','checks':rows}

def main():
    global until
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--stage',choices=('before','after'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--absolute-until',type=float,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--public-volume-anchor-base64',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--public-volume-anchor-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--source-pins-base64',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--source-pins-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--synthetic-binding-base64',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--synthetic-binding-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--native-binding-base64',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--native-binding-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--wal-binding-base64',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--wal-binding-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--sandbox-profile-sha256',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();os.umask(0o077)
    need(math.isfinite(args.absolute_until) and START<args.absolute_until<=START+45,
         'one_original_capture_deadline')
    until=args.absolute_until
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(sig,interrupted)
    report={'schema':'heptabao.mac-guarded-current-capture-entry.wal-r1','stage':args.stage,
        'ok':False,'outcomeUnknown':False,'productionReadAttempted':False,
        'productionWriteAttempted':False,'captureLibraryReturned':False,
        'providerRequestSent':False,'j3160Contacted':False,
        'wholeDatabaseBackupQualified':False,'crossAgentAtomicSnapshotClaimed':False,
        'originalCaptureSeconds':45,'captureLibraryAttempted':False,
        'captureLibraryLedgerAvailable':False,'captureLibraryFailureLedgerAvailable':False}
    guard=None;commands=None;cap=None;wal=None;complete=False;capsule=None;native_api=None
    try:
        need(sys.platform=='darwin' and os.getuid()==501,'actual_mac_capture_owner')
        pins_raw=base64.b64decode(args.source_pins_base64,validate=True)
        need(len(pins_raw)<=8192 and sha(pins_raw)==args.source_pins_sha256,'exact_entry_source_pins')
        pins=json.loads(pins_raw)
        need(isinstance(pins,dict) and set(pins)==set(NAMES)
             and all(isinstance(v,str) and len(v)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in v)
                     for v in pins.values()) and pins['mac_guarded_current_capture_r3.py']==CAPTURE_SOURCE_SHA,
             'fixed_public_capture_modules')
        need(pins.get('mac_registry_readonly_wal_r1.py')==WAL_BINDING['librarySha256'],
             'exact_qualified_registry_wal_library')
        need(all(pins.get(name)==pin for name,pin in NATIVE_BINDING['modulePins'].items()),
             'exact_qualified_native_capture_modules')
        source_ids={}
        for name,pin in pins.items():
            raw,source_ids[name]=source_bytes(QA/name);need(sha(raw)==pin,'capture_public_source_pin')
        sys.path.insert(0,str(QA))
        from mac_t5_volume_guard_r1 import HeldT5
        need(all(name[:-3] not in sys.modules for name in NATIVE_BINDING['modulePins']),
             'new_native_capture_modules_not_preloaded')
        from mac_darwin_owned_projection_r1 import NativeProjection
        from mac_native_owned_unreaped_r1 import bind_projection
        from mac_native_owned_commands_r1 import Commands
        import mac_guarded_current_capture_r3 as capture
        import mac_registry_readonly_wal_r1 as wal_capture
        cap=capture;wal=wal_capture
        class SignalState:
            @property
            def pending(self):return pending
            def critical(self):return critical()
        remaining()
        native_api=NativeProjection(until=until)
        report['nativeSelfBefore']=native_api.qualify_self(until=until)
        bind_projection(native_api)
        commands=Commands(SignalState())
        anchor=base64.b64decode(args.public_volume_anchor_base64,validate=True)
        guard=HeldT5(anchor,args.public_volume_anchor_sha256,remaining,critical)
        row,out,_=commands.run('capture-t5-volume',
            ['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist','/Volumes/T5'],
            until=min(until,time.monotonic()+30),maximum=262144)
        need(row['exitCode']==0 and not row['outcomeUnknown'] and row['completeBeforeDeadline'],
             'capture_volume_probe_complete')
        guard.accept_diskutil(out)
        native_raw=base64.b64decode(args.native_binding_base64,validate=True)
        need(len(native_raw)<=8192 and sha(native_raw)==args.native_binding_sha256,
             'actual_native_public_binding')
        _,native_proof=admitted_native(guard,json.loads(native_raw))
        need(native_api.public()['identity']==native_proof['nativeProjection']['identity'],
             'same_actual_native_abi_os_and_loaded_image_observations')
        report['nativePublicProofSha256']=NATIVE_BINDING['stdoutSha256']
        report['nativePublicAuthoritySha256']=NATIVE_BINDING['authoritySha256']
        report['nativePublicChildSha256']=NATIVE_BINDING['childStdoutSha256']
        report['actualNativeRuntimeCompatible']=True
        remaining()
        binding_raw=base64.b64decode(args.synthetic_binding_base64,validate=True)
        need(len(binding_raw)<=8192 and sha(binding_raw)==args.synthetic_binding_sha256,
             'actual_synthetic_public_binding')
        proof,proof_value=admitted_synthetic(guard,json.loads(binding_raw))
        wal_binding_raw=base64.b64decode(args.wal_binding_base64,validate=True)
        need(len(wal_binding_raw)<=8192 and sha(wal_binding_raw)==args.wal_binding_sha256,
             'actual_registry_wal_public_binding')
        wal_proof,wal_proof_value=admitted_wal(guard,json.loads(wal_binding_raw))
        need(wal_proof_value.get('runtime',{}).get('runtime')==proof_value['runtime'],
             'same_original_immutable_and_registry_wal_runtime')
        report['walSyntheticProofSha256']=WAL_BINDING['stdoutSha256']
        report['walSyntheticAuthoritySha256']=WAL_BINDING['authoritySha256']
        # Both original immutable predicates and the WAL runtime/source gate
        # execute with tracked public-code descriptors inside the one library
        # attempt, before it opens any current config or database.
        profile=guard.read(ROOT/'captures'/args.stage/'capture.sb',65536)
        need(profile==capture_profile(args.stage) and sha(profile)==args.sandbox_profile_sha256,
             'exact_reviewed_capture_sandbox')
        report['kernelSandboxProof']=kernel_refusals(guard,args.stage)
        remaining();guard.check()
        report['productionReadAttempted']=True
        report['captureLibraryAttempted']=True
        document,observation=wal.capture_current_with_wal(
            critical=critical,cancelled=lambda:pending is not None,
            synthetic_proof=proof,synthetic_proof_sha=sha(proof),
            wal_proof=wal_proof,wal_proof_sha=sha(wal_proof),until=until)
        report['captureLibraryReturned']=True
        report['observation']=capture_envelope(observation)
        report['captureLibraryLedgerAvailable']=True
        report['runtime']=document['runtime']
        need(document.get('walSyntheticProofSha256')==WAL_BINDING['stdoutSha256'],
             'private_capsule_actual_wal_proof_binding')
        report['syntheticProofSha256']=sha(proof)
        need(document['runtime']==proof_value['runtime'],'same_actual_capture_runtime')
        remaining()
        capsule_raw=capture.encoded(document)
        need(len(capsule_raw)<=4*1024*1024,'private_capsule_bound')
        output=ROOT/'captures'/args.stage/'output/capsule.private.json'
        capsule=guard.write_new(output,capsule_raw)
        report['capsule']={'path':str(output),**capsule}
        for name,pin in pins.items():
            raw,observed=source_bytes(QA/name)
            need(sha(raw)==pin and observed==source_ids[name],'capture_sources_after')
        report['nativeSelfAfter']=native_api.qualify_self(until=until)
        before_self=report['nativeSelfBefore']['first'];after_self=report['nativeSelfAfter']['last']
        need(all(before_self[key]==after_self[key] for key in
             ('pid','ppid','pgid','uid','birthSeconds','birthMicroseconds')),
             'same_current_capture_native_self_birth')
        guard.check();remaining();complete=True
    except BaseException as error:
        if wal is not None and isinstance(error,wal.CaptureAttemptFailure):
            try:
                report['observation']=capture_envelope(error.public)
                report['captureLibraryLedgerAvailable']=True
                report['captureLibraryFailureLedgerAvailable']=True
            except BaseException:
                report['captureLibraryLedgerAvailable']=False
                report['captureLibraryFailureLedgerAvailable']=False
        report['errorType']=type(error).__name__
        report['errorCode']=str(error) if isinstance(error,Refused) or (
            cap is not None and isinstance(error,cap.CaptureRefused)) else None
        observation=report.get('observation',{})
        report['outcomeUnknown']=bool(
            (report['captureLibraryAttempted'] and
             (not report['captureLibraryLedgerAvailable']
              or observation.get('observationUnknown') is not False
              or not library_resources_closed(observation)))
            or isinstance(error,KeyboardInterrupt))
    finally:
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(sig,signal.SIG_IGN)
        for row in reversed(fds):close_fd(row)
        for row in reversed(sockets):
            if not row['closeAttempted']:
                with critical():
                    row['closeAttempted']=True
                    try:row['socket'].close();row['closed']=True
                    except BaseException as error:row['closeErrorType']=type(error).__name__
        if commands is not None:report['ownedCommands']=commands.public()
        if native_api is not None:report['nativeProjection']=native_api.public()
        if guard is not None:
            guard.close();report['heldT5Final']=guard.public_state()
        closed=(all(row['closed'] for row in fds) and all(row['closed'] for row in sockets)
            and guard is not None and report['heldT5Final']['allDescriptorsClosed']
            and report['heldT5Final']['lastAnchorCheckPassed']
            and report['heldT5Final']['closeErrors']==[])
        stopped=(commands is not None and report['ownedCommands']['allOwnedCommandsStopped']
                 and report['ownedCommands']['unknownCommandCount']==0)
        library_closed=(not report['captureLibraryAttempted'] or
            (report['captureLibraryLedgerAvailable'] and library_resources_closed(report.get('observation'))))
        report['entryOwnedDescriptorsClosed']=closed
        report['allCaptureLibraryResourcesClosed']=library_closed
        report['allOwnedDescriptorsClosed']=bool(closed and library_closed)
        report['outcomeUnknown']=bool(report['outcomeUnknown'] or not closed or not library_closed
                                     or not stopped or pending is not None)
        done=time.monotonic()
        report['elapsedSeconds']=done-START
        report['originalAbsoluteDeadlineMonotonic']=until
        report['originalDeadlineMetAfterPrivatePublicationAndClosure']=done<until
        report['ok']=bool(complete and capsule is not None and closed and library_closed and stopped
                          and not report['outcomeUnknown'] and done<until)
        report['authoritativeExitZeroAndOriginalDeadlineRequired']=True
        raw=encoded(report);need(len(raw)<=262144,'public_capture_report_bound')
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    return 0 if report['ok'] and time.monotonic()<until else 1

if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create two independent auth-only Mac fixtures from an admitted bounded capsule.

Library only. No source database is opened here. All SQLite writes target new,
exclusive files below the two fixed phase roots. Effective auth is never a
materialization or inverse input. Models and flags come from captured config.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, copy, hashlib, json, math, os, re, sqlite3, stat, time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('/Volumes/T5/hepta-vnext-recovery-20261013/mac-authbus-4e808-current-registry-wal-r1')
LIVE=Path('/Users/qianqi/.openclaw')
SDK=Path('/opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/openclaw')
CODEX=LIVE/'npm/projects/openclaw-codex-8902d781d4__openclaw-generation__g-49fd4dbfde2c5057/node_modules/@openclaw/codex'
AGENTS=('main','trnm','hepta-ui','hepta','hepta-backend')
PHASES=('initial','cold-new-process')
TABLES=(('store','auth_profile_store','store_key','store_json'),
        ('state','auth_profile_state','state_key','state_json'))
CACHE_NAMES=('applied-profiles.json','publish-baseline.json','bad-refresh-quarantine.json',
             'refresh-backoff.json','lease-epochs.json','status.json')
CONFIG_SHA='ca2dd7d7879fa901dfb24e00837b56a4e0fd230600d7ed1e3086eda194187d4d'
MAX_ROW=1024*1024

class Refused(RuntimeError):pass
def need(value,code):
    if not value:raise Refused(code)
def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def digest(value):return sha(encoded(value))
def ident(s):
    return tuple(str(v) for v in (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_mode,
        s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns))
def no_nonfinite(value):
    if type(value) is float:need(math.isfinite(value),'finite_captured_json_number')
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for item in value:no_nonfinite(item)
    elif isinstance(value,dict):
        need(all(isinstance(k,str) for k in value),'json_object_keys')
        for item in value.values():no_nonfinite(item)

def consumer_profile(phase,port,source_pins,ca_file,harness_roots):
    need(phase in PHASES and type(port) is int and 1024<=port<=65535,'fixed_consumer_sandbox')
    root=ROOT/phase
    need(Path(ca_file)==ROOT/'credentials-consumer/ca.crt','only_owned_ca')
    # The exact installed code and the new phase are readable; production
    # current DB/config/auth/cache values and other phase/control roots are not.
    q=lambda value:json.dumps(str(value))
    lines=['(version 1)','(deny default)','(allow process*)',
        '(allow signal (target children))','(allow sysctl-read)','(allow mach-lookup)',
        '(allow file-read-metadata)']
    for path in ('/System','/usr','/bin','/sbin','/Library','/private/etc','/opt/homebrew','/dev/fd'):
        lines.append('(allow file-read* (subpath '+q(path)+'))')
    for path in (ROOT/'qa',ROOT/'installed-plugin-copy',root):
        lines.append('(allow file-read* (subpath '+q(path)+'))')
    # Installed immutable package roots are public code. Reading their package
    # modules is necessary for the real Node loader and its transitive imports.
    need(isinstance(harness_roots,list) and 1<=len(harness_roots)<=8
         and len(set(harness_roots))==len(harness_roots),'actual_finite_harness_root_set')
    for value in sorted(set([str(CODEX),*harness_roots])):
        path=Path(value)
        need(path.is_absolute() and path==Path(os.path.normpath(str(path)))
             and path.is_relative_to(LIVE/'npm/projects'),'public_installed_harness_code_scope')
        lines.append('(allow file-read* (subpath '+q(path)+'))')
    for path in sorted(source_pins):
        lines.append('(allow file-read* (literal '+q(path)+'))')
    for path in (ROOT/'credentials-consumer/ca.crt',
                 ROOT/'credentials-consumer/role_id',ROOT/'credentials-consumer/secret_id'):
        lines.append('(allow file-read* (literal '+q(path)+'))')
    lines.extend(['(allow file-read* (literal "/dev/urandom"))',
        '(allow file-read* (literal "/dev/random"))',
        '(allow file-write* (subpath '+q(root)+'))',
        '(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null"))',
        '(allow network-outbound (remote ip '+q('localhost:'+str(port))+'))'])
    return ('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode()

class Materializer:
    def __init__(self,guard,signals,until):
        need(guard.uuid_verified and not guard.closed,'held_t5_before_materialization')
        self.guard=guard;self.signals=signals;self.until=until
        self.connections=[];self.fds=[];self.started=False;self.completed=False
        self.created=[];self.phase_public=[];self.close_errors=[]

    def remaining(self,until=None):
        need(self.signals.pending is None,'materialization_cancelled')
        left=min(self.until,until if until is not None else self.until)-time.monotonic()
        need(left>0,'original_outer_or_owned_sqlite_deadline');return left

    def mkdir(self,path):
        self.remaining();self.guard.mkdir_new(path);self.created.append(str(path))

    def write(self,path,raw):
        self.remaining();result=self.guard.write_new(path,raw);self.remaining();return result

    def close_fd(self,row):
        if row['closeAttempted']:return
        with self.signals.critical():
            row['closeAttempted']=True
            try:os.close(row['fd']);row['closed']=True
            except BaseException as error:
                row['closeErrorType']=type(error).__name__;self.close_errors.append(type(error).__name__)

    def close_connection(self,row):
        if row['closeAttempted']:return
        with self.signals.critical():
            row['closeAttempted']=True
            try:row['db'].close();row['closed']=True
            except BaseException as error:
                row['closeErrorType']=type(error).__name__;self.close_errors.append(type(error).__name__)

    def owned_database(self,path,create_and_verify):
        self.remaining()
        need(any(path.is_relative_to(ROOT/phase/'state') for phase in PHASES),
             'only_new_phase_databases')
        fdrow=None;connection=None
        with self.guard.parent(path) as (parent,name):
            try:
                with self.signals.critical():
                    fd=os.open(name,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600,dir_fd=parent)
                    fdrow={'fd':fd,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False};self.fds.append(fdrow)
                before=os.fstat(fd)
                need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid==501 and before.st_nlink==1
                     and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode)==0o600 and before.st_size==0
                     and ident(before)==ident(os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)),
                     'new_empty_owned_database')
                query_until=min(self.until,time.monotonic()+3.0)
                self.remaining(query_until)
                with self.signals.critical():
                    db=sqlite3.connect(str(path),timeout=0.0,isolation_level=None)
                    connection={'db':db,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False}
                    self.connections.append(connection)
                db.enable_load_extension(False)
                need(hasattr(db,'setlimit'),'same_runtime_sqlite_limits_required')
                db.setlimit(sqlite3.SQLITE_LIMIT_LENGTH,MAX_ROW+65536)
                db.setlimit(sqlite3.SQLITE_LIMIT_SQL_LENGTH,32768)
                db.set_progress_handler(lambda:1 if time.monotonic()>=query_until else 0,1000)
                db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE')
                db.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=FULL')
                db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')
                db.execute('PRAGMA max_page_count=8192')
                db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
                create_and_verify(db,query_until)
                self.remaining(query_until);db.execute('COMMIT')
                self.close_connection(connection);need(connection['closed'],'owned_database_connection_closed')
                self.remaining(query_until)
                after=os.fstat(fd);named=os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)
                need(ident(after)==ident(named) and ident(before)[:6]==ident(after)[:6]
                     and 512<=after.st_size<=32*1024*1024,'same_created_database_inode')
                os.fsync(fd);os.fsync(parent)
                for suffix in ('-wal','-shm','-journal'):
                    try:os.stat(name+suffix,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)
                    except FileNotFoundError:pass
                    else:raise Refused('owned_materialized_database_sidecar_remaining')
                self.remaining()
                return {'path':str(path),'bytes':after.st_size,'identity':list(ident(after))}
            finally:
                if connection is not None:self.close_connection(connection)
                if fdrow is not None:self.close_fd(fdrow)

    def auth_database(self,path,rows):
        need(isinstance(rows,dict) and set(rows)=={'store','state'},'two_primary_table_documents')
        for kind,_,_,_ in TABLES:
            values=rows[kind]
            need(isinstance(values,list) and len(values)<=1,'captured_primary_only')
            for row in values:
                need(isinstance(row,list) and len(row)==3 and row[0]=='primary'
                     and isinstance(row[1],str) and len(row[1].encode())<=MAX_ROW
                     and type(row[2]) is int and 0<=row[2]<=9007199254740991,
                     'exact_auth_row_shape_and_timestamp')
                need(isinstance(json.loads(row[1]),dict),'auth_payload_object')
        def create(db,until):
            for kind,table,key,column in TABLES:
                self.remaining(until)
                db.execute('CREATE TABLE '+table+' ('+key+' TEXT PRIMARY KEY,'+
                           column+' TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)')
                db.executemany('INSERT INTO '+table+' VALUES (?,?,?)',rows[kind])
                actual=[list(row) for row in db.execute('SELECT '+key+','+column+
                    ',updated_at FROM '+table+' ORDER BY '+key)]
                need(actual==rows[kind],'original_primary_payload_and_timestamp_exact')
        return self.owned_database(path,create)

    def registry_database(self,path,registry):
        need(isinstance(registry,dict) and set(registry)=={'schema','columns','row','tableInfo'},
             'complete_captured_registry_shape')
        columns=registry['columns'];row=registry['row'];ddl=registry['schema']
        need(isinstance(columns,list) and len(columns)==len(set(columns))==13
             and all(isinstance(x,str) and re.fullmatch('[a-z_]+',x) for x in columns)
             and 'index_key' in columns and isinstance(row,list) and len(row)==13
             and row[columns.index('index_key')]=='installed-plugin-index'
             and isinstance(ddl,str) and len(ddl.encode())<=16384
             and re.match(r'(?is)^\s*CREATE\s+TABLE\s+(?:"installed_plugin_index"|installed_plugin_index)\s*\(',ddl),
             'one_actual_thirteen_column_registry')
        no_nonfinite(registry)
        def create(db,until):
            self.remaining(until)
            # execute accepts one statement. No ATTACH, virtual table, extension,
            # function invocation or second statement is authorized.
            forbidden={sqlite3.SQLITE_ATTACH,sqlite3.SQLITE_DETACH,sqlite3.SQLITE_FUNCTION,
                       sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_VTABLE,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_VTABLE}
            db.set_authorizer(lambda action,*_args:sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY if action in forbidden else sqlite3.SQLITE_OK)
            db.execute(ddl)
            names=','.join('"'+name+'"' for name in columns)
            db.execute('INSERT INTO installed_plugin_index ('+names+') VALUES ('+
                       ','.join('?' for _ in columns)+')',row)
            actual=db.execute('SELECT '+names+' FROM installed_plugin_index WHERE index_key=?',
                              ('installed-plugin-index',)).fetchall()
            need([list(x) for x in actual]==[row],'whole_captured_registry_row')
            need([list(x) for x in db.execute('PRAGMA table_info(installed_plugin_index)')]
                 ==registry['tableInfo'],'whole_registry_column_contract')
            stored=db.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='installed_plugin_index'").fetchall()
            need(stored==[(ddl,)],'registry_ddl_preserved_exact')
            self.remaining(until)
        return self.owned_database(path,create)

    def validate_capsule(self,document):
        need(isinstance(document,dict) and document.get('schema')=='heptabao.mac-guarded-current-inputs.private.r1'
             and document.get('sourceConfigSha256')==CONFIG_SHA and document.get('agentIds')==list(AGENTS)
             and document.get('scope')=='bounded_point_in_time_observation_not_database_or_cross_agent_snapshot',
             'admitted_current_capsule_shape')

        need(len(config_raw)<=MAX_ROW and sha(config_raw)==CONFIG_SHA,'captured_config_whole_pin')
        cfg=json.loads(config_raw)
        declared=cfg.get('agents',{}).get('list')
        need(isinstance(declared,list) and [x.get('id') for x in declared]==list(AGENTS),
             'all_actual_five_agents')
        docs=document['authDocuments']
        need(isinstance(docs,list) and len(docs)==5 and [x.get('agent') for x in docs]==list(AGENTS),
             'five_ordered_current_primary_documents')
        for item in docs:
            need(item.get('captureScope')=='two_fixed_primary_keys_only'
                 and item.get('nonprimaryRowsCaptured') is False,'honest_primary_materialization_scope')
        cache=document['authbusCaches']
        need(isinstance(cache,dict) and set(cache)=={'directoryPresent','files'}
             and type(cache['directoryPresent']) is bool and set(cache['files'])==set(CACHE_NAMES),
             'all_six_current_cache_bytes_or_absence')
        for value in cache['files'].values():
            need(isinstance(value,dict) and type(value.get('present')) is bool,'typed_cache_presence')
            if value['present']:

                need(cache['directoryPresent'] and value['mode']==0o600
                     and type(value['bytes']) is int and len(raw)==value['bytes']<=MAX_ROW
                     and sha(raw)==value['sha256'],'current_cache_whole_bytes')

    def materialize(self,document,*,plugin_config,managed_profiles,runtime,source_pins,
                    qa_pins,port,server_certificate_sha256):
        need(not self.started,'materialization_once')
        self.started=True

        need(set(document['nativeHomes'])==set(AGENTS)
             and set(document['models'])==set(AGENTS),'all_current_model_native_inputs')
        original_plugin=cfg['plugins']['entries']['openclaw-authbus']['config']
        without=lambda obj:{k:v for k,v in obj.items() if k not in ('address','caFile','roleIdFile','secretIdFile')}
        need(without(plugin_config)==without(original_plugin)
             and original_plugin.get('hostId')=='mac' and original_plugin.get('leader') is False
             and original_plugin.get('publishNew') is True and original_plugin.get('manageOrder') is True,
             'complete_actual_authbus_flags_preserved')

             and isinstance(runtime['harnessOwnerPluginIds'],list)

                 for path,pin in source_pins.items()),'fixed_installed_source_pins')

                need(not (directory/'codex-home/auth.json').exists(),'no_production_native_auth_copy')
                declared=next(x for x in cfg['agents']['list'] if x['id']==agent)
                selected=declared.get('model',cfg['agents']['defaults'].get('model'))

                need(isinstance(model_string,str) and '/' in model_string,'actual_agent_model')
                provider,model_id=model_string.split('/',1)

                captured=document['models'][agent]

                     and captured['sourceConfigSha256']==CONFIG_SHA
                     and captured['declaredModelSha256']==sha(encoded(selected)+b'\n'),'actual_per_agent_model_binding')
                prefix=work/'workers'/('native-'+agent)
                native_workers[agent]={

                    'nativeErrorOutput':str(prefix)+'.error.private.json',

                    'nativeAccountOutput':str(prefix)+'.account.private.json'}

            if document['authbusCaches']['directoryPresent']:
                self.mkdir(state/'authbus')
                for name,value in document['authbusCaches']['files'].items():
                    if value['present']:self.write(state/'authbus'/name,base64.b64decode(value['base64'],validate=True))
            sandbox=work/'consumer.sb'
            policy=consumer_profile(phase,port,phase_pins,plugin_config['caFile'],runtime['harnessCodeRoots'])
            self.write(sandbox,policy);phase_pins[str(sandbox)]=sha(policy)
            common={**runtime,'workRoot':str(ROOT),'phaseRoot':str(work),'stateRoot':str(state),
                'pluginConfig':copy.deepcopy(plugin_config),'originalPluginConfig':copy.deepcopy(original_plugin),
                'serverCertificateSha256':server_certificate_sha256,'managedProfiles':copy.deepcopy(managed_profiles),
                'model':native_workers['main']['model'],'sourcePins':phase_pins,
                'originalAuthRowsDigestByAgent':{agent:digest(documents[agent]['rows']) for agent in AGENTS},
                'originalCacheContentSha256':digest(document['authbusCaches']),
                'baselineOutput':str(work/'baseline.private.json'),
                'candidateOutput':str(work/'candidate.private.json'),
                'rollbackCheckpointOutput':str(work/'candidate.private.json'),
                'rollbackOnce':str(work/'inverse/rollback-once.private.json'),
                'parentSandbox':str(sandbox)}
            for mode,generation in (('consume',phase),('inverse',phase+'-inverse')):
                plan={'schema':'heptabao.mac-five-agent-phase-plan.private.r1','generation':generation,
                    'phase':phase,'mode':mode,'agentIds':list(AGENTS),'phaseSeconds':120,
                    'phaseRoot':str(work),'stateRoot':str(state),
                    'expectedVolumeDevice':self.guard.expected['expectedVolumeDevice'],
                    'qaPins':dict(qa_pins),'workerCommon':copy.deepcopy(common),
                    'nativeWorkers':copy.deepcopy(native_workers)}
                binding=self.write(ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.private.json'),encoded(plan))
                plans.append({'generation':generation,**binding})
            self.phase_public.append({'phase':phase,'agents':list(AGENTS),'authOnlyDatabases':database_records,
                'rawRowsDigests':common['originalAuthRowsDigestByAgent'],
                'originalCacheContentSha256':common['originalCacheContentSha256'],
                'originalConfigSha256':CONFIG_SHA,'ownedConfigSha256':sha(encoded(scoped)),
                'perAgentModelsBoundToActualConfig':True,'inheritedEffectiveProfilesMaterialized':False,
                'productionNativeAuthCopied':False,'nonprimaryDatabaseTablesCopied':False})
        self.remaining();self.guard.check()
        need(not self.close_errors and all(x['closed'] for x in self.fds)
             and all(x['closed'] for x in self.connections),'all_materialization_descriptors_closed')
        self.completed=True
        return {'plans':plans,'phases':self.phase_public,'sameCapturedBaselineForBothIndependentPhases':True,
                'crossAgentAtomicSnapshotClaimed':False}

    def close(self):
        for row in reversed(self.connections):self.close_connection(row)
        for row in reversed(self.fds):self.close_fd(row)

    def public(self):
        return {'started':self.started,'completed':self.completed,'createdDirectoryCount':len(self.created),
            'ownedDatabaseConnections':len(self.connections),
            'allOwnedDescriptorsClosed':all(x['closed'] for x in self.fds)
                and all(x['closed'] for x in self.connections),
            'closeErrors':list(self.close_errors),'productionDatabaseOpened':False}

        local=[];parent=None

            for component in path.parent.parts:
                self.remaining()

                anchor=next((x for x in self.guard.expected['anchors'] if x['path']==str(current)),None)
                parent_identity=parent_custody_identity(current,named,anchor,public_code)

                self.wait(raw,deadline,False)
                error=raw.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_ERROR)
                if error:raise OSError(error,os.strerror(error))
            self.left(deadline)
            with self.ctx.critical():
                tls=self.ssl.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='localhost',
                    do_handshake_on_connect=False,suppress_ragged_eofs=False)
                tls_row={'socket':tls,'attempted':False,'closed':False,'transferred':False}
                self.sockets.append(tls_row);socks.append(tls_row)
                need(raw.fileno()==-1,'raw_socket_transferred_to_registered_tls')
                raw_row['transferred']=True
            while True:
                self.left(deadline)
                try:tls.do_handshake();break
                except ssl.SSLWantReadError:self.wait(tls,deadline,True)
                except ssl.SSLWantWriteError:self.wait(tls,deadline,False)
            self.left(deadline)
            need(tls.selected_alpn_protocol() in (None,'http/1.1')
                 and sha(tls.getpeercert(binary_form=True))==self.peer_sha,'actual_trusted_tls_peer')
            row['tlsVerified']=True;row['peerSha256']=self.peer_sha
            payload=b'' if body is None else canonical(body)
            need(len(payload)<=MAX_HTTP_BODY,'control_request_body_bound')
            actual_token=self.root_token if token is None else token
            headers=[method+' /v1/'+route+' HTTP/1.1','Host: 127.0.0.1:'+str(self.port),
                     'Connection: close','Content-Length: '+str(len(payload))]
            if body is not None:headers.append('Content-Type: application/json')
            if actual_token:
                need(isinstance(actual_token,str) and len(actual_token)<=8192
                     and re.fullmatch('[\x21-\x7e]+',actual_token),'private_token_header_shape')
                headers.append('X-Vault-Token: '+actual_token)
            request=('\r\n'.join(headers)+'\r\n\r\n').encode('ascii')+payload
            row['dispatched']=True
            self.send(tls,request,deadline)
            status,reply,framing=self.response(tls,deadline)
            self.left(deadline)
            row.update(status=status,responseBytes=len(reply),responseSha256=sha(reply),
                       framing=framing,responseComplete=True)
            result={} if not reply else exact_json(reply)
            need(isinstance(result,dict),'typed_json_response_object')
            need(status==expected,'exact_expected_http_status')
            if validate is not None:validate(result)
            self.left(deadline);row['responseValidated']=True
        except BaseException as error:
            row['errorType']=type(error).__name__
            row['errorCode']=str(error) if isinstance(error,Refused) else None
            if row['dispatched']:self.unknown=True
            raise
        finally:
            for sock in reversed(socks):self.close(sock)
            row['socketClosuresComplete']=all(s['closed'] for s in socks)
            completed_at=time.monotonic()
            row['elapsedSeconds']=completed_at-started
            row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline']=completed_at<deadline
            row['outcomeUnknown']=bool((row['dispatched'] and (not row['responseValidated']
                or not row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline'])) or not row['socketClosuresComplete'])
            self.unknown=bool(self.unknown or row['outcomeUnknown'])
            if row['responseValidated'] and row['socketClosuresComplete'] and row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline']:
                self.inflight=None
            elif not row['dispatched'] and row['socketClosuresComplete']:
                # A known refused TCP connection before sending is only usable
                # by the explicit bounded readiness loop, not a mutation retry.
                self.inflight=None
            else:self.unknown=True
        need(not self.unknown and row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline'],'complete_http_terminal_deadline')
        return result
    def ready(self,status):
        deadline=min(self.ctx.until,time.monotonic()+NEW_LISTENER_READY_SECONDS)
        for attempt in range(120):
            self.left(deadline)
            try:return self.call('listener-ready-'+str(attempt),'GET','sys/health',
                                 token='',expected=status,until=deadline)
            except ConnectionRefusedError:
                need(not self.unknown and self.inflight is None,'known_not_sent_ready_refusal')
                time.sleep(min(0.05,self.left(deadline)))
        raise Refused('finite_listener_readiness_exhausted')
    def close_all(self):
        for row in reversed(self.sockets):self.close(row)
    def public(self):
        return {'requests':list(self.rows),'requestCount':len(self.rows),
            'inflight':None if self.inflight is None else {
                k:self.inflight[k] for k in ('name','method','route','dispatched')},
            'outcomeUnknown':self.unknown,
            'allOwnedSocketsClosed':all(row['closed'] for row in self.sockets),
            'onlyEndpoint':'127.0.0.1:'+str(self.port),'originalPerRequestSeconds':10,
            'newListenerReadySeconds':NEW_LISTENER_READY_SECONDS,'redirectsFollowed':0,
            'businessRequestsReplayed':0}

def add_secrets(values,value):

            if isinstance(item,str) and len(item)>=8 and key not in ('provider','type','chatgptPlanType'):
                values.add(item)

    elif isinstance(value,list):

    ctx.port_reservation=row

    finally:

def generated_read_fsync(ctx,guard,path,maximum):
    row=None
    with guard.parent(path) as (parent,name):
        try:
            with ctx.critical():
                row=ctx.fd(os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK,dir_fd=parent),'owned-generated')
            first=os.fstat(row['fd'])
            need(stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_uid==501 and first.st_nlink==1
                 and stat.S_IMODE(first.st_mode)==0o600 and 0<first.st_size<=maximum,
                 'owned_generated_file_custody')
            raw=bytearray()
            while len(raw)<=first.st_size:
                ctx.remaining();part=os.read(row['fd'],min(65536,first.st_size+1-len(raw)))
                if not part:break
                raw.extend(part)
            os.fsync(row['fd']);os.fsync(parent)
            need(len(raw)==first.st_size and ident(first)==ident(os.fstat(row['fd']))
                 ==ident(os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)),'owned_generated_whole_read_and_fsync')
            return bytes(raw)
        finally:
            if row is not None:ctx.close(row)
            need(row is None or row['closed'],'owned_generated_close')

def tls_material(ctx,guard,commands):
    tls=ROOT/'server/tls'
    extension=b'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1\nsubjectKeyIdentifier=hash\nauthorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always\n'
    guard.write_new(tls/'leaf.ext',extension)
    calls=(
      ('owned-ca',['/usr/bin/openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes',
        '-keyout',str(tls/'ca.key'),'-out',str(tls/'ca.crt'),'-days','2','-subj','/CN=heptabao-mac-owned-ca',
        '-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE','-addext','keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign',
        '-addext','subjectKeyIdentifier=hash','-addext','authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always']),
      ('owned-leaf-request',['/usr/bin/openssl','req','-new','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes',
        '-keyout',str(tls/'server.key'),'-out',str(tls/'server.csr'),'-subj','/CN=localhost']),
      ('owned-leaf-sign',['/usr/bin/openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(tls/'server.csr'),
        '-CA',str(tls/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(tls/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial',
        '-out',str(tls/'server.crt'),'-days','2','-extfile',str(tls/'leaf.ext')]))
    for label,argv in calls:
        row,out,err=commands.run(label,argv,until=min(ctx.until,time.monotonic()+30),maximum=262144)
        need(row['exitCode']==0 and row['completeBeforeDeadline'] and not row['outcomeUnknown'],
             'owned_tls_material_command')
        ctx.remaining()
    files={}
    for name in ('ca.key','ca.crt','server.key','server.csr','server.crt','ca.srl'):
        files[name]=generated_read_fsync(ctx,guard,tls/name,65536)
    ca=files['ca.crt'];certificate=files['server.crt']
    peer=sha(ssl.PEM_cert_to_DER_cert(certificate.decode('ascii')))
    need(all(b'PRIVATE KEY' not in value for name,value in files.items() if name in ('ca.crt','server.crt')),
         'public_certificates_not_keys')
    return ca,peer,{name:sha(value) for name,value in files.items()}

        payload={'schemaVersion':1,'profileId':pid,'credential':copy.deepcopy(credential),'digest':pin,'identity':identity}
        entry={k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k not in ('credential','schemaVersion')}
        entry.update(key=key,provider=credential['provider'],type=credential['type'],
                     expires=credential['expires'],quarantined=False,status='active')
        profiles['profiles/'+key]=payload;entries.append(entry)

    docs={**profiles,'order-policy':order,'scheduler-assignments':{

def critical():
    global protected

        need(isinstance(pins,dict) and set(pins)==set(PUBLIC_MODULES)
             and all(isinstance(v,str) and len(v)==64
                     and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in v) for v in pins.values()),
             'fixed_public_source_set')
        source_identities={}
        for name in PUBLIC_MODULES:
            raw,source_identities[name]=stable_public(QA/name,1024*1024)
            need(sha(raw)==pins[name],'reviewed_public_source')
        sys.path.insert(0,str(QA))
        from mac_t5_volume_guard_r1 import HeldT5
        from mac_owned_commands_r1 import Signals,Commands
        from mac_native_process_observer_r1 import ProcessReader
        # Commands uses this wrapper's critical section and cancellation state.
        class CommandSignals:
            @property
            def pending(self):return pending
            def critical(self):return critical()
        commands=Commands(CommandSignals())
        anchor=base64.b64decode(args.public_volume_anchor_base64,validate=True)
        guard=HeldT5(anchor,args.public_volume_anchor_sha256,remaining,critical)
        row,out,err=commands.run('server-wrapper-t5-volume',
            ['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist','/Volumes/T5'],
            until=min(UNTIL,time.monotonic()+30),maximum=262144)
        need(row['exitCode']==0 and row['completeBeforeDeadline']
             and not row['outcomeUnknown'],'actual_volume_probe_complete')
        guard.accept_diskutil(out)
        report['ownedPrivateInputReadAttempted']=True
        raw=guard.read(args.plan)
        report['ownedPrivateInputReadCompleted']=True
        need(sha(raw)==args.plan_sha256,'exact_private_server_plan')
        plan=json.loads(raw);need(isinstance(plan,dict),'server_plan_object');generation=plan.get('generation')
        need(isinstance(plan,dict) and set(plan)=={'schema','generation','binaryPath',
            'binarySha256','binaryBytes','configPath','configSha256','port','workRoot'}
            and plan['schema']=='heptabao.mac-owned-launchd-server-plan.private.r1'
            and generation in GENERATIONS and args.plan==ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.private.json')
            and plan['binaryPath']==str(BINARY) and plan['binarySha256']==BINARY_SHA
            and plan['binaryBytes']==BINARY_BYTES and plan['configPath']==str(ROOT/'server/server.json')
            and plan['workRoot']==str(ROOT) and type(plan['port']) is int
            and 1024<=plan['port']<=65535,'fixed_owned_server_plan')
        config_raw=guard.read(Path(plan['configPath']))
        need(sha(config_raw)==plan['configSha256'],'exact_server_config')
        config=json.loads(config_raw)
        need(isinstance(config,dict) and set(config)=={'listen','data_dir','audit_file',
             'tls_cert_file','tls_key_file','storage'}
             and config['listen']=='127.0.0.1:'+str(plan['port'])
             and config['data_dir']==str(ROOT/'server/data')
             and config['audit_file']==str(ROOT/'server/audit.jsonl'),
             'actual_normal_flat_loopback_config')
        need(config['storage']=={'native_v6_file':{'path':str(ROOT/'server/data')}},
             'formal_owned_native_v6_file')
        need(config['tls_cert_file']==str(ROOT/'server/tls/server.crt')
             and config['tls_key_file']==str(ROOT/'server/tls/server.key'),
             'owned_tls_configuration')
        before_binary=binary_pin()
        reader=ProcessReader();self_identity=reader.read(os.getpid())
        need(self_identity['uid']==501 and self_identity['pid']==self_identity['pgid']
             and self_identity['executable']==str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),
             'actual_launchd_wrapper_identity')
        ready={'schema':'heptabao.mac-server-wrapper-ready.r1','generation':generation,
            'planSha256':args.plan_sha256,'wrapperIdentity':self_identity,
            'wrapperStartMonotonic':START,'originalWrapperDeadlineMonotonic':UNTIL}
        guard.write_new(ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.ready.public.json'),encoded(ready))
        admitted=ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.admitted.private.json')
        while True:
            remaining()
            try:admission=json.loads(guard.read(admitted));break
            except FileNotFoundError:time.sleep(min(0.025,remaining()))
        need(admission=={'schema':'heptabao.mac-owned-manager-admission.r1',
            'generation':generation,'planSha256':args.plan_sha256,'wrapperIdentity':self_identity},
            'one_exact_actual_manager_admission')
        need(reader.read(os.getpid())==self_identity,'wrapper_birth_before_exec')
        need(binary_pin()==before_binary,'binary_name_identity_before_exec')
        need(sha(guard.read(Path(plan['configPath'])))==plan['configSha256'],
             'config_after_manager_admission')
        for name in PUBLIC_MODULES:
            raw,observed=stable_public(QA/name,1024*1024)
            need(observed==source_identities[name] and sha(raw)==pins[name],
                 'public_sources_before_exec')
        report.update(generation=generation,wrapperIdentity=self_identity,
            binaryPath=str(BINARY),binarySha256=BINARY_SHA,binaryBytes=BINARY_BYTES,
            binaryIdentity=before_binary,configSha256=plan['configSha256'],
            sourcePins=pins,commands=commands.public())
        need(report['commands']['allOwnedCommandsStopped']
             and report['commands']['unknownCommandCount']==0,'helpers_closed_before_exec')
        remaining();guard.check()
        report['preparedExecCandidate']=True
        candidate=guard.write_new(ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.exec-ready.public.json'),
                                 encoded(report))
    except BaseException as error:
        report['errorType']=type(error).__name__
        report['errorCode']=str(error) if isinstance(error,Refused) else None
        report['outcomeUnknown']=isinstance(error,KeyboardInterrupt)
    finally:
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(sig,signal.SIG_IGN)
        if commands is not None:report['commands']=commands.public()
        if guard is not None:
            guard.close();report['volumeGuardClosed']=guard.public_state()
        closed=(guard is not None and report['volumeGuardClosed']['allDescriptorsClosed']
            and report['volumeGuardClosed']['lastAnchorCheckPassed']
            and not report['volumeGuardClosed']['closeErrors'])
        owned=(commands is not None and report['commands']['allOwnedCommandsStopped']
               and report['commands']['unknownCommandCount']==0)
        ready=bool(candidate is not None and closed and owned and pending is None
                   and time.monotonic()<UNTIL and 'errorType' not in report)
        report['ok']=ready;report['readyToExec']=ready
        report['outcomeUnknown']=bool(report['outcomeUnknown'] or not closed or not owned)
        report['candidateReceiptSha256']=None if candidate is None else candidate['sha256']
        report['elapsedSeconds']=time.monotonic()-START
        print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
    if not ready or time.monotonic()>=UNTIL:return 1
    # A successful exec retains PID/birth and consumes this wrapper. The
    # independent manager must actually observe that transition and pinned file.
    try:
        for name in ('SIGTERM','SIGINT','SIGPIPE','SIGXFZ','SIGXFSZ'):
            sig=getattr(signal,name,None)
            if sig is not None:signal.signal(sig,signal.SIG_DFL)
        os.execve(str(BINARY),[str(BINARY),'--config',str(ROOT/'server/server.json')],
            {'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C',
             'HOME':str(ROOT/'server/home'),'TMPDIR':str(ROOT/'server/tmp')})
    except BaseException as error:
        print(json.dumps({'schema':'heptabao.mac-owned-server-exec-failure.r1',
            'generation':generation,'ok':False,'execFailureType':type(error).__name__,
            'outcomeUnknown':False},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
        return 1

if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Closed Darwin numeric projection for a new public custody probe.

Apple exact source is a reference ABI, never a pin of the installed kernel.
No library is loaded at import time. Runtime uses two fixed install names and
records dladdr image names, the actual kernel/build, structure layout and an
own-process behavioral cross-check. It never lists all host PIDs or names.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import ctypes, errno, os, re, sys, time

REFERENCE_XNU='f6217f891ac0bb64f3d375211650a4c1ff8ca1ea'
REFERENCE_DYLD='fd8d0c4d52320ebf64db34f3cb280310d905c5ae'
KERNEL_INSTALL_NAME='/usr/lib/system/libsystem_kernel.dylib'
SYSTEM_INSTALL_NAME='/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib'
PROJECTION_SCHEMA='heptabao.darwin-proc-bsdinfo-numeric.r1'
PROC_PGRP_ONLY=2
PROC_PIDTBSDINFO=3
INCLUDE_RETAINED_ZOMBIES=1
MAX_GROUP_MEMBERS=64
GROUP_CAPACITY=MAX_GROUP_MEMBERS+1
MAX_CALLS=4096
QUERY_SECONDS=4.0
BSD_SIZE=136
STATE_CODES={1:'SIDL',2:'SRUN',3:'SSLEEP',4:'SSTOP',5:'SZOMB'}

class NativeProjectionRefused(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self,code,errno_value=None):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code=code
        self.public_errno=(errno_value if type(errno_value) is int and 0<errno_value<=4095 else None)

def need(condition,code,errno_value=None):
    if not condition:raise NativeProjectionRefused(code,errno_value)

class ProcBSDInfo(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[
        ('pbi_flags',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_status',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_xstatus',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_pid',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_ppid',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_uid',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_gid',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_ruid',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_rgid',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_svuid',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_svgid',ctypes.c_uint32),('rfu_1',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_comm',ctypes.c_char*16),('pbi_name',ctypes.c_char*32),
        ('pbi_nfiles',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_pgid',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('pbi_pjobc',ctypes.c_uint32),('e_tdev',ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('e_tpgid',ctypes.c_uint32),('pbi_nice',ctypes.c_int32),
        ('pbi_start_tvsec',ctypes.c_uint64),('pbi_start_tvusec',ctypes.c_uint64)]

class DlInfo(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('dli_fname',ctypes.c_char_p),('dli_fbase',ctypes.c_void_p),
              ('dli_sname',ctypes.c_char_p),('dli_saddr',ctypes.c_void_p)]

EXPECTED_OFFSETS={
    'pbi_flags':0,'pbi_status':4,'pbi_xstatus':8,'pbi_pid':12,'pbi_ppid':16,
    'pbi_uid':20,'pbi_gid':24,'pbi_ruid':28,'pbi_rgid':32,'pbi_svuid':36,
    'pbi_svgid':40,'rfu_1':44,'pbi_comm':48,'pbi_name':64,'pbi_nfiles':96,
    'pbi_pgid':100,'pbi_pjobc':104,'e_tdev':108,'e_tpgid':112,'pbi_nice':116,
    'pbi_start_tvsec':120,'pbi_start_tvusec':128}

def abi_layout():
    sizes={'int':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_int),'int32':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_int32),
           'uint32':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_uint32),'uint64':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_uint64),
           'pointer':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_void_p),'size_t':ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_size_t),
           'proc_bsdinfo':ctypes.sizeof(ProcBSDInfo),'Dl_info':ctypes.sizeof(DlInfo)}
    offsets={name:getattr(ProcBSDInfo,name).offset for name,_ in ProcBSDInfo._fields_}
    need(sizes=={'int':4,'int32':4,'uint32':4,'uint64':8,'pointer':8,
                 'size_t':8,'proc_bsdinfo':136,'Dl_info':32},
         'reference_abi_size_mismatch')
    need(offsets==EXPECTED_OFFSETS and ctypes.alignment(ProcBSDInfo)==8
         and [getattr(DlInfo,name).offset for name,_ in DlInfo._fields_]==[0,8,16,24],
         'reference_abi_offset_mismatch')
    need(sys.byteorder=='little','reference_abi_endianness')
    return {'sizes':sizes,'offsets':offsets,'alignment':8,'endianness':'little'}

def stable(row):
    return {key:row[key] for key in ('pid','ppid','pgid','uid','birthSeconds','birthMicroseconds')}

def project_bsdinfo(value,expected_pid):
    pid=int(value.pbi_pid);ppid=int(value.pbi_ppid);pgid=int(value.pbi_pgid)
    state=int(value.pbi_status);sec=int(value.pbi_start_tvsec);usec=int(value.pbi_start_tvusec)
    need(type(expected_pid) is int and 0<expected_pid<=0x7fffffff and pid==expected_pid,
         'native_pid_identity_mismatch')
    need(0<ppid<=0x7fffffff and 0<pgid<=0x7fffffff,'native_parent_or_group_malformed')
    need(state in STATE_CODES,'native_process_state_unsupported')
    need(0<sec<2**63 and 0<=usec<1000000,'native_birth_malformed')
    # comm/name/exit details and all other struct bytes are never published.
    return {'pid':pid,'ppid':ppid,'pgid':pgid,'uid':int(value.pbi_uid),
            'stateCode':state,'stateName':STATE_CODES[state],'isZombie':state==5,
            'birthSeconds':str(sec),'birthMicroseconds':str(usec)}

class NativeProjection:
    def __init__(self,*,until):
        need(sys.platform=='darwin' and os.uname().machine=='arm64' and os.geteuid()==501,
             'fixed_darwin_arm64_operator')
        self.layout=abi_layout();self.calls=0;self.pid_calls=0;self.group_calls=0
        self.last_call=None;self.self_qualified=False;self.identity=None
        self._check_deadline(until)
        self.kernel=ctypes.CDLL(KERNEL_INSTALL_NAME,use_errno=True)
        self.system=ctypes.CDLL(SYSTEM_INSTALL_NAME,use_errno=True)
        self._check_deadline(until)
        self._list=self.kernel.proc_listpids
        self._list.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint32,ctypes.c_uint32,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
        self._list.restype=ctypes.c_int
        self._info=self.kernel.proc_pidinfo
        self._info.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_uint64,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
        self._info.restype=ctypes.c_int
        self._sysctl=self.system.sysctlbyname
        self._sysctl.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t),
                              ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_size_t]
        self._sysctl.restype=ctypes.c_int
        self._dladdr=self.system.dladdr
        self._dladdr.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.POINTER(DlInfo)]
        self._dladdr.restype=ctypes.c_int
        images={}
        for name,function in (('proc_listpids',self._list),('proc_pidinfo',self._info),
                              ('sysctlbyname',self._sysctl),('dladdr',self._dladdr)):
            images[name]=self._symbol_image(name,function,until)
        build=self._os_build(until)
        uname=os.uname()
        self.identity={'referenceXnuCommit':REFERENCE_XNU,'referenceDyldCommit':REFERENCE_DYLD,
            'referenceIsInstalledWholePin':False,
            'requestedInstallNames':[KERNEL_INSTALL_NAME,SYSTEM_INSTALL_NAME],
            'loadedSymbolImages':images,'libraryWholeFileHashClaimed':False,
            'sharedCacheMaterializationAttempted':False,
            'dylibHandlesRetainedUntilProcessExit':True,
            'actualKernel':{'sysname':uname.sysname,'release':uname.release,
                            'version':uname.version,'machine':uname.machine},
            'actualOsBuild':build,'abi':self.layout}
        self._check_deadline(until)

    @staticmethod
    def _check_deadline(until):
        need(type(until) in (int,float) and time.monotonic()<until,
             'original_projection_deadline_expired')

    def _begin(self,kind,until):
        self._check_deadline(until)
        need(self.calls<MAX_CALLS,'native_projection_call_bound')
        self.calls+=1
        end=min(until,time.monotonic()+QUERY_SECONDS)
        self.last_call={'kind':kind,'call':self.calls,'returned':False,'errno':None}
        self._check_deadline(end)
        return end

    def _end(self,result,deadline):
        error=ctypes.get_errno()
        self.last_call.update({'returned':True,'result':int(result),
                              'errno':error if 0<error<=4095 else None})
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        return error

    def _symbol_image(self,name,function,until):
        deadline=self._begin('fixed_symbol_dladdr',until);info=DlInfo()
        ctypes.set_errno(0)
        result=self._dladdr(ctypes.cast(function,ctypes.c_void_p),ctypes.byref(info))
        self._end(result,deadline)
        need(result!=0 and info.dli_fname is not None,'fixed_symbol_image_unavailable')
        image=bytes(info.dli_fname)
        symbol=bytes(info.dli_sname) if info.dli_sname is not None else b''
        need(0<len(image)<=512 and image.startswith(b'/usr/lib/')
             and b'\0' not in image and 0<len(symbol)<=128,'fixed_system_symbol_image_shape')
        need(symbol.lstrip(b'_')==name.encode('ascii'),'fixed_symbol_name_mismatch')
        return {'requestedSymbol':name,'observedImagePath':image.decode('ascii'),
                'observedSymbolName':symbol.decode('ascii'),
                'addressesPublished':False,'imageWholeBytesPinned':False}

    def _os_build(self,until):
        deadline=self._begin('kern.osversion',until)
        buf=ctypes.create_string_buffer(128);size=ctypes.c_size_t(128)
        ctypes.set_errno(0)
        result=self._sysctl(b'kern.osversion',buf,ctypes.byref(size),None,0)
        error=self._end(result,deadline)
        need(result==0 and error==0 and 2<=size.value<=128,'fixed_os_build_query',error)
        raw=bytes(buf.raw[:size.value])
        need(raw[-1:]==b'\0' and re.fullmatch(rb'[A-Za-z0-9.()-]{1,64}',raw[:-1]) is not None,
             'fixed_os_build_shape')
        return raw[:-1].decode('ascii')

    def pid_row(self,pid,*,until):
        need(type(pid) is int and 0<pid<=0x7fffffff,'closed_numeric_pid_argument')
        deadline=self._begin('owned_pid_tbsdinfo',until)
        info=ProcBSDInfo();self.pid_calls+=1;ctypes.set_errno(0)
        size=self._info(pid,PROC_PIDTBSDINFO,INCLUDE_RETAINED_ZOMBIES,ctypes.byref(info),BSD_SIZE)
        error=self._end(size,deadline)
        need(error==0 and size==BSD_SIZE,'native_pid_info_not_complete',error)
        row=project_bsdinfo(info,pid)
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        return row

    def _group_ids(self,pgid,*,until):
        need(type(pgid) is int and 0<pgid<=0x7fffffff,'closed_numeric_group_argument')
        deadline=self._begin('retained_pgrp_only',until)
        self.group_calls+=1
        buffer=(ctypes.c_int32*GROUP_CAPACITY)(*([-1]*GROUP_CAPACITY))
        capacity=ctypes.sizeof(buffer);ctypes.set_errno(0)
        size=self._list(PROC_PGRP_ONLY,pgid,ctypes.byref(buffer),capacity)
        error=self._end(size,deadline)
        # A full buffer may be truncated. Never grow it, retry, or enumerate all PIDs.
        need(error==0 and 0<=size<capacity and size%4==0,
             'native_group_error_short_or_truncated',error)
        ids=[int(buffer[i]) for i in range(size//4)]
        need(len(ids)<=MAX_GROUP_MEMBERS and len(set(ids))==len(ids)
             and all(0<pid<=0x7fffffff for pid in ids),'native_group_pid_shape')
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        return sorted(ids)

    def group_rows(self,pgid,*,until):
        deadline=min(until,time.monotonic()+QUERY_SECONDS)
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        before=self._group_ids(pgid,until=deadline)
        rows=[self.pid_row(pid,until=deadline) for pid in before]
        need(all(row['pgid']==pgid and row['uid']==os.geteuid() for row in rows),
             'native_group_scope_or_uid_changed')
        after=self._group_ids(pgid,until=deadline)
        need(before==after,'native_group_members_changed')
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        return rows

    def qualify_self(self,*,until):
        pid=os.getpid();pgid=os.getpgrp()
        need(pid==pgid,'sandbox_owner_must_be_group_leader')
        first=self.pid_row(pid,until=until)
        need(first['ppid']==os.getppid() and first['pgid']==pgid
             and first['uid']==os.geteuid() and not first['isZombie'],
             'native_self_behavioral_crosscheck')
        rows=self.group_rows(pgid,until=until)
        # No child has been started in this sandbox at qualification.
        need(len(rows)==1 and stable(rows[0])==stable(first),'native_self_group_crosscheck')
        last=self.pid_row(pid,until=until)
        need(stable(first)==stable(last) and not last['isZombie'],'native_self_birth_stable')
        self.self_qualified=True
        return {'projectionSchema':PROJECTION_SCHEMA,'first':first,'last':last,
                'groupRows':rows,'pidUidPpidPgidMatchedIndependentOsApis':True}

    def public(self):
        return {'schema':PROJECTION_SCHEMA,'identity':self.identity,
                'selfQualified':self.self_qualified,'nativeCalls':self.calls,
                'pidQueries':self.pid_calls,'groupQueries':self.group_calls,
                'lastCall':self.last_call,'maxGroupMembers':MAX_GROUP_MEMBERS,
                'pidListNullBufferUsed':False,'allHostEnumerationUsed':False,
                'commandNamesOrPathsProjected':False,'querySeconds':QUERY_SECONDS,
                'lateNativeReturnRejected':True,
                'synchronousKernelCallHasNoSeparateKillableWorker':True}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded current Mac credential observation; no whole-database copy.

Library only: no import-time I/O, subprocess, SQL, write or CLI entry. Its caller
must be an explicitly reviewed sandbox-exec capture process with production
writes and all networking denied. Actual synthetic SQLite proof is mandatory.
Immutable intentionally skips SQLite change detection; our held FD/name fences
do not turn this into a SQLite transaction snapshot or a cross-agent snapshot.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, hashlib, json, os, re, sqlite3, stat, sys, time, _sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

LIVE=Path('/Users/qianqi/.openclaw')
AGENTS=('main','trnm','hepta-ui','hepta','hepta-backend')
CACHE_NAMES=('applied-profiles.json','publish-baseline.json','bad-refresh-quarantine.json',
             'refresh-backoff.json','lease-epochs.json','status.json')
TABLES=(('store','auth_profile_store','store_key','store_json'),
        ('state','auth_profile_state','state_key','state_json'))
CONFIG_SHA='ca2dd7d7879fa901dfb24e00837b56a4e0fd230600d7ed1e3086eda194187d4d'
MIB=1024*1024
MAX_RETURNED_AND_READ_BYTES=8*MIB
MAX_ROW_BYTES=MIB
MAX_QUERY_SECONDS=3.0
NEW_CAPTURE_SECONDS=45.0

class CaptureRefused(RuntimeError):pass
def need(value,code):
    if not value:raise CaptureRefused(code)
def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def identity(s):
    return tuple(str(v) for v in (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_mode,
                                 s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns))
def parent_identity(s):return identity(s)[:5]

class FixedInputs:
    def __init__(self, *, until, critical, cancelled, live=LIVE, synthetic=False):
        need(callable(critical) and callable(cancelled),'descriptor_signal_and_cancellation_guards_required')
        synthetic_root=Path('/Volumes/T5/hepta-vnext-recovery-20261013/mac-authbus-r10-current-consumer-r1/capture-sqlite-synthetic-r1')
        need(live==LIVE or (synthetic and Path(live).is_relative_to(synthetic_root)),
             'synthetic_root_requires_fixed_owned_component_scope')
        self.live=Path(live);self.synthetic=synthetic;self.until=until;self.critical=critical;self.cancelled=cancelled
        self.fds=[];self.parents={};self.files={};self.absent={};self.connections=[];self.byte_count=0
        self.closed=False;self.close_errors=[];self.verified=False
        self.uid=os.geteuid()
        need(self.uid==501 or synthetic,'actual_mac_uid')
    def remaining(self,until=None):
        need(not self.cancelled(),'capture_cancelled')
        n=min(self.until,until if until is not None else self.until)-time.monotonic()
        need(n>0,'original_capture_or_query_deadline_exhausted')
        return n
    def _open_fd(self,name,flags,parent=None):
        self.remaining()
        with self.critical():
            fd=os.open(name,flags,**({} if parent is None else {'dir_fd':parent}))
            row={'fd':fd,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False};self.fds.append(row)
        return row
    def parent(self,path):
        path=Path(path)
        need(path.is_absolute() and path==Path(os.path.normpath(str(path)))
             and path.is_relative_to(self.live),'fixed_current_input_scope')
        target=path.parent
        previous=None
        for directory in [Path('/'),*reversed(target.parents),target]:
            # reversed(target.parents) already contains '/'; do not observe it twice.
            key=str(directory)
            if key in self.parents:
                previous=self.parents[key];continue
            if directory==Path('/'):
                name='/';named=os.lstat('/')
            else:
                need(previous is not None and Path(previous['path'])==directory.parent,
                     'held_parent_chain_order')
                name=directory.name
                named=os.stat(name,dir_fd=previous['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
            known_synthetic_mount=(self.synthetic and directory==Path('/Volumes/T5')
                and named.st_uid==0 and named.st_gid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)==0o775)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(named.st_mode) and (known_synthetic_mount
                 or not stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)&0o022),'current_parent_plain_no_external_write')
            # The component's separate HeldT5 UUID/whole-identity guard admits
            # only this actual root-owned mount; production /Users code has no exception.
            if directory==self.live or directory.is_relative_to(self.live):
                need(named.st_uid==self.uid,'current_parent_owner')
            row=self._open_fd(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                              None if previous is None else previous['fd'])
            need(parent_identity(os.fstat(row['fd']))==parent_identity(named),'held_parent_open_identity')
            row.update(path=key,name=name,parent=previous,expected=parent_identity(named))
            self.parents[key]=row;previous=row
        need(previous['path']==str(target),'exact_current_input_parent')
        return previous

        path=Path(path);key=str(path)
