class LoopbackHTTP:
    """One TLS connection per explicit request, no redirect or retry.

    Nonblocking socket/SSL operations and all framing share one original ten
    second absolute deadline. A full, typed response and actual socket closure
    must precede clearing the operation record.
    """
    def __init__(self,ctx,port,ca_pem,peer_sha):
        need(type(port) is int and 1024<=port<=65535 and valid_pin(peer_sha),'fixed_loopback_tls')
        self.ctx=ctx;self.port=port;self.peer_sha=peer_sha
        self.ssl=ssl.create_default_context(cadata=ca_pem.decode('ascii'))
        self.ssl.check_hostname=True;self.ssl.verify_mode=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
        self.ssl.set_alpn_protocols(['http/1.1'])
        self.rows=[];self.sockets=[];self.inflight=None;self.unknown=False
        self.root_token=None;self.secrets=[]
    def left(self,until):return self.ctx.remaining(until)
    def wait(self,sock,until,reading):
        left=self.left(until)
        r,w,e=select.select([sock] if reading else [],[] if reading else [sock],[sock],left)
        self.left(until);need(not e and bool(r or w),'loopback_socket_readiness')
    def close(self,row):
        if row['attempted']:return
        with self.ctx.critical():
            row['attempted']=True
            try:row['socket'].close();row['closed']=row['socket'].fileno()==-1
            except BaseException as error:row['errorType']=type(error).__name__
        if not row['closed']:self.unknown=True
    def recv(self,sock,until):
        while True:
            self.left(until)
            try:return sock.recv(65536)
            except ssl.SSLWantReadError:self.wait(sock,until,True)
            except ssl.SSLWantWriteError:self.wait(sock,until,False)
    def send(self,sock,raw,until):
        offset=0
        while offset<len(raw):
            self.left(until)
            try:
                n=sock.send(memoryview(raw)[offset:]);need(n>0,'tls_write_progress');offset+=n
            except ssl.SSLWantReadError:self.wait(sock,until,True)
            except ssl.SSLWantWriteError:self.wait(sock,until,False)
    def response(self,sock,until):
        buffer=bytearray()
        while b'\r\n\r\n' not in buffer:
            need(len(buffer)<=65536,'http_head_bound')
            part=self.recv(sock,until);need(bool(part),'http_head_complete');buffer.extend(part)
        boundary=buffer.index(b'\r\n\r\n')
        need(boundary<=65536,'http_head_bound')
        head=bytes(buffer[:boundary]);buffer=buffer[boundary+4:]
        lines=head.split(b'\r\n')
        match=re.fullmatch(rb'HTTP/1[.]1 ([0-9]{3}) [\x20-\x7e]*',lines[0])
        need(match is not None,'one_http11_response')
        status=int(match.group(1));need(200<=status<=599,'no_interim_or_upgrade_profile')
        headers={}
        for line in lines[1:]:
            name,separator,value=line.partition(b':')
            need(separator and re.fullmatch(rb"[!#$%&'*+.^_\x60|~0-9A-Za-z-]+",name)
                 and b'\x00' not in value,'unfolded_http_header')
            headers.setdefault(name.lower(),[]).append(value.strip())
        lengths=headers.get(b'content-length',[]);transfer=headers.get(b'transfer-encoding',[])
        need(len(lengths)<=1 and len(transfer)<=1 and not(lengths and transfer),'unambiguous_http_framing')
        need(headers.get(b'content-encoding',[]) in ([],[b'identity']),'uncompressed_json_response')
        def append_more():
            part=self.recv(sock,until);need(bool(part),'http_body_complete')
            buffer.extend(part);need(len(buffer)<=MAX_HTTP_BODY+65536,'bounded_http_buffer')
        if status in (204,304):
            need(not transfer and lengths in ([],[b'0']) and not buffer,'empty_status_frame')
            return status,b'','no-body'
        if lengths:
            need(re.fullmatch(rb'[0-9]{1,10}',lengths[0]) is not None,'decimal_content_length')
            length=int(lengths[0]);need(length<=MAX_HTTP_BODY,'http_body_bound')
            while len(buffer)<length:append_more()
            need(len(buffer)==length,'one_content_length_response_no_surplus')
            return status,bytes(buffer),'content-length'
        if transfer:
            need(transfer==[b'chunked'],'only_explicit_chunked_transfer')
            body=bytearray();chunks=0
            while True:
                while b'\r\n' not in buffer:
                    need(len(buffer)<=128,'chunk_size_line_bound');append_more()
                end=buffer.index(b'\r\n');line=bytes(buffer[:end]);del buffer[:end+2]
                need(len(line)<=128 and re.fullmatch(rb'[0-9a-fA-F]{1,8}(?:;[\x20-\x7e]*)?',line),
                     'typed_chunk_size')
                size=int(line.split(b';')[0],16);chunks+=1
                need(chunks<=32768 and len(body)+size<=MAX_HTTP_BODY,'bounded_chunked_body')
                if size==0:
                    # No trailers are needed by this API. Reject unreviewed
                    # trailing metadata rather than infer successful framing.
                    while len(buffer)<2:append_more()
                    need(bytes(buffer)==b'\r\n','empty_exact_chunk_trailer')
                    return status,bytes(body),'chunked'
                while len(buffer)<size+2:append_more()
                need(buffer[size:size+2]==b'\r\n','chunk_data_crlf')
                body.extend(buffer[:size]);del buffer[:size+2]
        need(headers.get(b'connection',[])==[b'close'],'explicit_close_delimited_response')
        while True:
            part=self.recv(sock,until)
            if not part:break
            buffer.extend(part);need(len(buffer)<=MAX_HTTP_BODY,'http_body_bound')
        return status,bytes(buffer),'tls-close-notify'
    def call(self,label,method,route,body=None,*,token=None,expected=200,validate=None,until=None):
        need(self.inflight is None and not self.unknown,'no_http_after_unknown')
        need(re.fullmatch('[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,100}',label) and method in ('GET','POST','PUT','LIST')
             and re.fullmatch('[a-zA-Z0-9_./:-]{1,512}',route) and not route.startswith('/'),
             'explicit_safe_control_method_route')
        allowed_prefix=('sys/','auth/','openclaw-auth/')
        need(route.startswith(allowed_prefix),'owned_api_control_scope')
        started=time.monotonic();deadline=min(self.ctx.until,started+HTTP_SECONDS,
            until if until is not None else self.ctx.until)
        self.left(deadline);socks=[];result=None
        row={'name':label,'method':method,'route':route,'dispatched':False,
             'responseComplete':False,'responseValidated':False,'socketClosuresComplete':False,
             'originalRequestSeconds':10,'outcomeUnknown':False}
        self.rows.append(row);self.inflight=row
        try:
            with self.ctx.critical():
                raw=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                raw_row={'socket':raw,'attempted':False,'closed':False,'transferred':False}
                self.sockets.append(raw_row);socks.append(raw_row)
            raw.setblocking(False)
            code=raw.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',self.port))
            if code not in (0,errno.EINPROGRESS,errno.EWOULDBLOCK,errno.EALREADY):
                raise OSError(code,os.strerror(code))
            if code:
                self.wait(raw,deadline,False)
                error=raw.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_ERROR)
                if error:raise OSError(error,os.strerror(error))
            self.left(deadline)
            with self.ctx.critical():
                tls=self.ssl.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='localhost',
                    do_handshake_on_connect=False,suppress_ragged_eofs=False)
                tls_row={'socket':tls,'attempted':False,'closed':False,'transferred':False}
                self.sockets.append(tls_row);socks.append(tls_row)
                need(raw.fileno()==-1,'raw_socket_transferred_to_registered_tls')
                raw_row['transferred']=True
            while True:
                self.left(deadline)
                try:tls.do_handshake();break
                except ssl.SSLWantReadError:self.wait(tls,deadline,True)
                except ssl.SSLWantWriteError:self.wait(tls,deadline,False)
            self.left(deadline)
            need(tls.selected_alpn_protocol() in (None,'http/1.1')
                 and sha(tls.getpeercert(binary_form=True))==self.peer_sha,'actual_trusted_tls_peer')
            row['tlsVerified']=True;row['peerSha256']=self.peer_sha
            payload=b'' if body is None else canonical(body)
            need(len(payload)<=MAX_HTTP_BODY,'control_request_body_bound')
            actual_token=self.root_token if token is None else token
            headers=[method+' /v1/'+route+' HTTP/1.1','Host: 127.0.0.1:'+str(self.port),
                     'Connection: close','Content-Length: '+str(len(payload))]
            if body is not None:headers.append('Content-Type: application/json')
            if actual_token:
                need(isinstance(actual_token,str) and len(actual_token)<=8192
                     and re.fullmatch('[\x21-\x7e]+',actual_token),'private_token_header_shape')
                headers.append('X-Vault-Token: '+actual_token)
            request=('\r\n'.join(headers)+'\r\n\r\n').encode('ascii')+payload
            row['dispatched']=True
            self.send(tls,request,deadline)
            status,reply,framing=self.response(tls,deadline)
            self.left(deadline)
            row.update(status=status,responseBytes=len(reply),responseSha256=sha(reply),
                       framing=framing,responseComplete=True)
            result={} if not reply else exact_json(reply)
            need(isinstance(result,dict),'typed_json_response_object')
            need(status==expected,'exact_expected_http_status')
            if validate is not None:validate(result)
            self.left(deadline);row['responseValidated']=True
        except BaseException as error:
            row['errorType']=type(error).__name__
            row['errorCode']=str(error) if isinstance(error,Refused) else None
            if row['dispatched']:self.unknown=True
            raise
        finally:
            for sock in reversed(socks):self.close(sock)
            row['socketClosuresComplete']=all(s['closed'] for s in socks)
            completed_at=time.monotonic()
            row['elapsedSeconds']=completed_at-started
            row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline']=completed_at<deadline
            row['outcomeUnknown']=bool((row['dispatched'] and (not row['responseValidated']
                or not row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline'])) or not row['socketClosuresComplete'])
            self.unknown=bool(self.unknown or row['outcomeUnknown'])
            if row['responseValidated'] and row['socketClosuresComplete'] and row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline']:
                self.inflight=None
            elif not row['dispatched'] and row['socketClosuresComplete']:
                # A known refused TCP connection before sending is only usable
                # by the explicit bounded readiness loop, not a mutation retry.
                self.inflight=None
            else:self.unknown=True
        need(not self.unknown and row['completedWithinOriginalDeadline'],'complete_http_terminal_deadline')
        return result
    def ready(self,status):
        deadline=min(self.ctx.until,time.monotonic()+NEW_LISTENER_READY_SECONDS)
        for attempt in range(120):
            self.left(deadline)
            try:return self.call('listener-ready-'+str(attempt),'GET','sys/health',
                                 token='',expected=status,until=deadline)
            except ConnectionRefusedError:
                need(not self.unknown and self.inflight is None,'known_not_sent_ready_refusal')
                time.sleep(min(0.05,self.left(deadline)))
        raise Refused('finite_listener_readiness_exhausted')
    def close_all(self):
        for row in reversed(self.sockets):self.close(row)
    def public(self):
        return {'requests':list(self.rows),'requestCount':len(self.rows),
            'inflight':None if self.inflight is None else {
                k:self.inflight[k] for k in ('name','method','route','dispatched')},
            'outcomeUnknown':self.unknown,
            'allOwnedSocketsClosed':all(row['closed'] for row in self.sockets),
            'onlyEndpoint':'127.0.0.1:'+str(self.port),'originalPerRequestSeconds':10,
            'newListenerReadySeconds':NEW_LISTENER_READY_SECONDS,'redirectsFollowed':0,
            'businessRequestsReplayed':0}

def add_secrets(values,value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        for key,item in value.items():
            if isinstance(item,str) and len(item)>=8 and key not in ('provider','type','chatgptPlanType'):
                values.add(item)
            elif isinstance(item,(dict,list)):add_secrets(values,item)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for item in value:add_secrets(values,item)

def generated_read_fsync(ctx,guard,path,maximum):
    row=None
    with guard.parent(path) as (parent,name):
        try:
            with ctx.critical():
                row=ctx.fd(os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK,dir_fd=parent),'owned-generated')
            first=os.fstat(row['fd'])
            need(stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_uid==501 and first.st_nlink==1
                 and stat.S_IMODE(first.st_mode)==0o600 and 0<first.st_size<=maximum,
                 'owned_generated_file_custody')
            raw=bytearray()
            while len(raw)<=first.st_size:
                ctx.remaining();part=os.read(row['fd'],min(65536,first.st_size+1-len(raw)))
                if not part:break
                raw.extend(part)
            os.fsync(row['fd']);os.fsync(parent)
            need(len(raw)==first.st_size and ident(first)==ident(os.fstat(row['fd']))
                 ==ident(os.stat(name,dir_fd=parent,follow_symlinks=False)),'owned_generated_whole_read_and_fsync')
            return bytes(raw)
        finally:
            if row is not None:ctx.close(row)
            need(row is None or row['closed'],'owned_generated_close')

def canonical_and_inbox(client,docs,phases):
    for index,(name,data) in enumerate(docs.items()):
        client.call('canonical-readback-'+str(len(phases))+'-'+str(index),'GET','openclaw-auth/data/'+name,
            validate=lambda v,data=data:need(exact_data(v).get('data')==data
                and v['data'].get('metadata',{}).get('version')==1,'canonical_scope_and_original_cas_exact'))
    paths=[]
    for phase in phases:
        cycle=phase['records'][0]['report']
        need(cycle.get('publishNewFlagPreserved') is True and cycle.get('workerManifestWriteRouteAllowed') is False,
             'original_publish_flag_and_canonical_scope')
        for item in cycle['wire']:
            if item['method']=='POST' and item['path'].startswith('/v1/openclaw-auth/data/inbox/mac/'):
                suffix=item['path'].split('/inbox/mac/',1)[1]
                need(re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}',suffix) and item.get('complete') is True
                     and item.get('status')==200,'actual_complete_inbox_post')
                paths.append(suffix)
    need(len(paths)==len(set(paths))<=256,'finite_distinct_observed_inbox_events')
    if paths:
        listed=client.call('inbox-list-'+str(len(phases)),'LIST','openclaw-auth/metadata/inbox/mac',
            validate=lambda v:need(isinstance(exact_data(v).get('keys'),list)
                and sorted(v['data']['keys'])==sorted(paths),'exact_observed_inbox_keyset'))
        for index,key in enumerate(sorted(paths)):
            client.call('inbox-read-'+str(len(phases))+'-'+str(index),'GET','openclaw-auth/data/inbox/mac/'+key,
                validate=lambda v:need(isinstance(exact_data(v).get('data'),dict),'actual_proposal_document'))
    else:
        client.call('inbox-absent-'+str(len(phases)),'LIST','openclaw-auth/metadata/inbox/mac',expected=404)
    return {'observedInboxPosts':len(paths),'canonicalDocumentCount':len(docs),
        'canonicalAllVersionOneAndWholePayloadExact':True,'publishNewUnchanged':True,
        'canonicalGrantAddedByConsumer':False,'coordinatorExecuted':False,
        'proposalPresenceNotInterpretedAsCanonicalGrant':True}

def scan_owned_plaintext(ctx,guard,packet):
    literals=[v.encode() for c in packet['credentials'].values() for key,v in c.items()
              if key in ('access','refresh') and isinstance(v,str) and v]
    roots=[ROOT/'server/data',*[ROOT/phase/'state/agents'/agent/'agent/codex-home'
           for phase in ('initial','cold-new-process') for agent in AGENTS]]
    seen=0;total=0;directories=0;server_files=0
    def fail(error):raise error
    for root in roots:
        if root!=ROOT/'server/data':
            try:(root/'auth.json').lstat()
            except FileNotFoundError:pass
            else:raise Refused('native_auth_json_must_remain_absent')
        for directory,subdirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False,onerror=fail):
            ctx.remaining();directories+=1;need(directories<=512,'finite_owned_plaintext_directories')
            for name in subdirs:
                need(stat.S_ISDIR((Path(directory)/name).lstat().st_mode),'no_owned_scan_symlink_directories')
            for name in files:
                seen+=1;need(seen<=512,'finite_owned_plaintext_files')
                if root==ROOT/'server/data':server_files+=1
                path=Path(directory)/name;info=path.lstat()
                need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_size<=16*1024*1024,
                     'bounded_owned_plaintext_file')
                raw=guard.read(path,16*1024*1024);total+=len(raw)
                need(total<=64*1024*1024 and all(value not in raw for value in literals),
                     'no_managed_provider_plaintext_in_server_or_native_homes')
    need(seen>0 and server_files>0,'actual_owned_server_disk_files_observed')
    return {'files':seen,'serverFiles':server_files,'directories':directories,'bytesRead':total,
            'providerAccessRefreshAbsent':True,'allTenNativeAuthFilesAbsent':True,
            'wholeProductionBackupClaimed':False}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded current Mac credential observation; no whole-database copy.

Library only: no import-time I/O, subprocess, SQL, write or CLI entry. Its caller
must be an explicitly reviewed sandbox-exec capture process with production
writes and all networking denied. Actual synthetic SQLite proof is mandatory.
Immutable intentionally skips SQLite change detection; our held FD/name fences
do not turn this into a SQLite transaction snapshot or a cross-agent snapshot.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, hashlib, json, os, re, sqlite3, stat, sys, time, _sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

LIVE=Path('/Users/qianqi/.openclaw')
AGENTS=('main','trnm','hepta-ui','hepta','hepta-backend')
CACHE_NAMES=('applied-profiles.json','publish-baseline.json','bad-refresh-quarantine.json',
             'refresh-backoff.json','lease-epochs.json','status.json')
TABLES=(('store','auth_profile_store','store_key','store_json'),
        ('state','auth_profile_state','state_key','state_json'))
CONFIG_SHA='ca2dd7d7879fa901dfb24e00837b56a4e0fd230600d7ed1e3086eda194187d4d'
MIB=1024*1024
MAX_RETURNED_AND_READ_BYTES=8*MIB
MAX_ROW_BYTES=MIB
MAX_QUERY_SECONDS=3.0
NEW_CAPTURE_SECONDS=45.0

class CaptureRefused(RuntimeError):pass
def need(value,code):
    if not value:raise CaptureRefused(code)
def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def identity(s):
    return tuple(str(v) for v in (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_mode,
                                 s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns))
def parent_identity(s):return identity(s)[:5]

class FixedInputs:
    def __init__(self, *, until, critical, cancelled, live=LIVE, synthetic=False):
        need(callable(critical) and callable(cancelled),'descriptor_signal_and_cancellation_guards_required')
        synthetic_root=Path('/Volumes/T5/hepta-vnext-recovery-20261013/mac-authbus-r10-current-consumer-r1/capture-sqlite-synthetic-r1')
        need(live==LIVE or (synthetic and Path(live).is_relative_to(synthetic_root)),
             'synthetic_root_requires_fixed_owned_component_scope')
        self.live=Path(live);self.synthetic=synthetic;self.until=until;self.critical=critical;self.cancelled=cancelled
        self.fds=[];self.parents={};self.files={};self.absent={};self.connections=[];self.byte_count=0
        self.closed=False;self.close_errors=[];self.verified=False
        self.uid=os.geteuid()
        need(self.uid==501 or synthetic,'actual_mac_uid')
    def remaining(self,until=None):
        need(not self.cancelled(),'capture_cancelled')
        n=min(self.until,until if until is not None else self.until)-time.monotonic()
        need(n>0,'original_capture_or_query_deadline_exhausted')
        return n
    def _open_fd(self,name,flags,parent=None):
        self.remaining()
        with self.critical():
            fd=os.open(name,flags,**({} if parent is None else {'dir_fd':parent}))
            row={'fd':fd,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False};self.fds.append(row)
        return row
    def parent(self,path):
        path=Path(path)
        need(path.is_absolute() and path==Path(os.path.normpath(str(path)))
             and path.is_relative_to(self.live),'fixed_current_input_scope')
        target=path.parent
        previous=None
        for directory in [Path('/'),*reversed(target.parents),target]:
            # reversed(target.parents) already contains '/'; do not observe it twice.
            key=str(directory)
            if key in self.parents:
                previous=self.parents[key];continue
            if directory==Path('/'):
                name='/';named=os.lstat('/')
            else:
                need(previous is not None and Path(previous['path'])==directory.parent,
                     'held_parent_chain_order')
                name=directory.name
                named=os.stat(name,dir_fd=previous['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
            known_synthetic_mount=(self.synthetic and directory==Path('/Volumes/T5')
                and named.st_uid==0 and named.st_gid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)==0o775)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(named.st_mode) and (known_synthetic_mount
                 or not stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)&0o022),'current_parent_plain_no_external_write')
            # The component's separate HeldT5 UUID/whole-identity guard admits
            # only this actual root-owned mount; production /Users code has no exception.
            if directory==self.live or directory.is_relative_to(self.live):
                need(named.st_uid==self.uid,'current_parent_owner')
            row=self._open_fd(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                              None if previous is None else previous['fd'])
            need(parent_identity(os.fstat(row['fd']))==parent_identity(named),'held_parent_open_identity')
            row.update(path=key,name=name,parent=previous,expected=parent_identity(named))
            self.parents[key]=row;previous=row
        need(previous['path']==str(target),'exact_current_input_parent')
        return previous
    def directory(self,path,*,optional=False):
        path=Path(path);key=str(path)
        if key in self.parents:return self.parents[key]
        parent=self.parent(path)
        try:named=os.stat(path.name,dir_fd=parent['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            need(optional,'required_current_directory_absent')
            self.absent[key]={'parent':parent,'name':path.name}
            return None
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(named.st_mode) and named.st_uid==self.uid
             and not stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)&0o022,'current_directory_custody')
        row=self._open_fd(path.name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,parent['fd'])
        need(parent_identity(os.fstat(row['fd']))==parent_identity(named),'current_directory_fd')
        row.update(path=key,name=path.name,parent=parent,expected=parent_identity(named))
        self.parents[key]=row
        return row
    def hold(self,path,*,optional=False,maximum=None,require_empty=False,private=True):
        path=Path(path);key=str(path)
        if key in self.files:return self.files[key]
        need(key not in self.absent,'absence_not_reopened_as_present')
        parent=self.parent(path)
        try:named=os.stat(path.name,dir_fd=parent['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            need(optional,'required_current_input_absent')
            self.absent[key]={'parent':parent,'name':path.name}
            return None
        need(stat.S_ISREG(named.st_mode) and named.st_uid==self.uid and named.st_nlink==1
             and (stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)==0o600 if private else
                  stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode)&0o022==0) and named.st_size>=0,'current_input_custody')
        if maximum is not None:need(named.st_size<=maximum,'current_input_size_bound')
        if require_empty:need(named.st_size==0,'nonempty_wal_refused_before_sqlite')
        row=self._open_fd(path.name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK,parent['fd'])
        need(identity(named)==identity(os.fstat(row['fd'])),'current_input_open_identity')
        row.update(path=key,parent=parent,name=path.name,expected=identity(named))
        self.files[key]=row
        return row
    def account(self,size):
        need(type(size) is int and size>=0,'byte_accounting')
        self.byte_count+=size
        need(self.byte_count<=MAX_RETURNED_AND_READ_BYTES,'capture_returned_and_read_byte_cap')
    def read(self,path,*,optional=False,maximum=MIB,private=True):
        row=self.hold(path,optional=optional,maximum=maximum,private=private)
        if row is None:return None
        os.lseek(row['fd'],0,os.SEEK_SET);parts=[];count=0
        while count<=maximum:
            self.remaining()
            data=os.read(row['fd'],min(65536,maximum+1-count))
            if not data:break
            count+=len(data);self.account(len(data));parts.append(data)
        need(count==int(row['expected'][6]),'current_input_read_length')
        self.verify()
        return b''.join(parts)
    def database(self,path):
        main=self.hold(path)
        need(int(main['expected'][6])>=512,'current_database_header_bound')
        wal=self.hold(Path(str(path)+'-wal'),optional=True,maximum=0,require_empty=True)
        shm=self.hold(Path(str(path)+'-shm'),optional=True,maximum=8*MIB)
        journal=self.hold(Path(str(path)+'-journal'),optional=True,maximum=0)
        need(journal is None,'rollback_journal_refused_before_immutable')
        # We deliberately do not read/copy the main database or SHM bytes.
        self.verify()
        return main
    def verify(self):
        self.remaining();self.verified=False
        for row in self.parents.values():
            named=os.lstat('/') if row['parent'] is None else os.stat(
                row['name'],dir_fd=row['parent']['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
            need(parent_identity(named)==parent_identity(os.fstat(row['fd']))==row['expected'],
                 'held_current_parent_changed')
        for row in self.files.values():
            named=os.stat(row['name'],dir_fd=row['parent']['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
            need(identity(named)==identity(os.fstat(row['fd']))==row['expected'],
                 'current_input_fd_name_or_metadata_changed')
        for row in self.absent.values():
            try:os.stat(row['name'],dir_fd=row['parent']['fd'],follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:pass
            else:raise CaptureRefused('current_input_absence_changed')
        self.remaining();self.verified=True
    def close(self):
        if self.closed:return
        for row in reversed(self.fds):
            if row['closeAttempted']:continue
            with self.critical():
                row['closeAttempted']=True
                try:os.close(row['fd']);row['closed']=True
                except BaseException as error:self.close_errors.append(type(error).__name__)
        self.closed=True
    def public(self):
        return {'boundedReadAndReturnedBytes':self.byte_count,
            'sqlitePageReadBytesMeasured':False,'wholeDatabaseCopied':False,
            'wholeDatabaseBackupQualified':False,'sqliteTransactionSnapshotClaimed':False,
            'crossAgentAtomicSnapshotClaimed':False,'observation':'bounded_point_in_time_with_fd_name_fences',
            'actualDatabaseSizes':{p:int(r['expected'][6]) for p,r in self.files.items() if p.endswith('.sqlite')},
            'files':{p:{'identity':list(r['expected'])} for p,r in self.files.items()},
            'absentPaths':list(self.absent),'allHeldNamesVerified':self.verified,
            'allOwnedDescriptorsClosed':self.closed and all(r['closed'] for r in self.fds)
                and all(r['closed'] for r in self.connections),
            'sqliteConnectionsOpened':len(self.connections),
            'sqliteConnectionsClosed':sum(r['closed'] for r in self.connections),
            'closeErrors':list(self.close_errors)}

def public_code_pin(path,*,remaining,critical):
    # Public interpreter/extension/source hashes have their own fixed 64MiB
    # per-file bound. They do not pretend to be measured SQLite page I/O.
    remaining();path=Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    with critical():
        fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    try:
        before=os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and 0<before.st_size<=64*MIB
             and not stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode)&0o022,'public_runtime_code_custody')
        digest=hashlib.sha256();count=0
        while count<=before.st_size:
            remaining()
            raw=os.read(fd,min(MIB,before.st_size+1-count))
            if not raw:break
            count+=len(raw);digest.update(raw)
        need(count==before.st_size and identity(before)==identity(os.fstat(fd))==identity(path.lstat()),
             'public_runtime_code_changed')
        remaining()
        result={'path':str(path),'bytes':count,'sha256':digest.hexdigest()}
    finally:
        with critical():os.close(fd)
    remaining()
    return result

def runtime_identity(*,remaining,critical):
    return {'pythonExecutable':public_code_pin(sys.executable,remaining=remaining,critical=critical),
            'sqliteExtension':public_code_pin(_sqlite3.__file__,remaining=remaining,critical=critical),
            'pythonVersion':sys.version,'sqliteVersion':sqlite3.sqlite_version,
            'sqliteVersionInfo':list(sqlite3.sqlite_version_info)}

         and proof.get('schema')=='heptabao.mac-immutable-capture-synthetic.r1'

         and proof.get('journalRefusedBeforeConnect') is True

def immutable_query(inputs,main,query):
    inputs.verify()
    until=min(inputs.until,time.monotonic()+MAX_QUERY_SECONDS)
    inputs.remaining(until)
    need(hasattr(sqlite3.Connection,'setlimit') and hasattr(sqlite3,'SQLITE_LIMIT_LENGTH'),
         'actual_sqlite_length_limit_support_required')
    # /dev/fd/N reopens the already held read-only inode. The same exact URI
    # and runtime must first pass the owned synthetic proof; there is no
    # named-path fallback and no initial production experiment.
    uri='file:/dev/fd/'+str(main['fd'])+'?mode=ro&immutable=1'
    with inputs.critical():
        db=sqlite3.connect(uri,uri=True,timeout=0.0,isolation_level=None)
        connection={'db':db,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False}

        db.setlimit(sqlite3.SQLITE_LIMIT_SQL_LENGTH,8192)
        db.enable_load_extension(False)

        db.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')
        need(db.execute('PRAGMA query_only').fetchone()==(1,),'connection_query_only')
        db.execute('BEGIN')

        inputs.remaining(until)
        db.execute('ROLLBACK')
    finally:
        with inputs.critical():
            connection['closeAttempted']=True
            try:db.close();connection['closed']=True
            except BaseException as error:
                inputs.close_errors.append(type(error).__name__)
                raise
    inputs.remaining(until);inputs.verify()
    return value

def auth_rows(inputs,agent):
    path=inputs.live/'agents'/agent/'agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite'
    main=inputs.database(path)
    def query(db,until):
        result={}
        allowed_tables={x[1] for x in TABLES}
        allowed_columns={t:{k,c,'updated_at'} for _,t,k,c in TABLES}
        def authorize(action,arg1,arg2,_db,_trigger):
            if action==sqlite3.SQLITE_SELECT:return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK
            if action==sqlite3.SQLITE_READ and arg1 in allowed_tables and arg2 in allowed_columns[arg1]:
                return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK
            if action==sqlite3.SQLITE_TRANSACTION and arg1 in ('ROLLBACK',):return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK
            return sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY
        db.set_authorizer(authorize)
        for kind,table,key,column in TABLES:
            inputs.remaining(until)
            rows=db.execute('SELECT '+key+','+column+',updated_at FROM '+table+
                            ' WHERE '+key+'=? LIMIT 2',('primary',)).fetchall()
            need(len(rows)<=1,'fixed_primary_row_count')
            for row in rows:
                need(len(row)==3 and row[0]=='primary' and isinstance(row[1],str)
                     and type(row[2]) is int and 0<=row[2]<=9007199254740991,'fixed_primary_row_shape')
                raw=row[1].encode('utf-8')
                need(len(raw)<=MAX_ROW_BYTES,'auth_primary_payload_cap')
                parsed=json.loads(raw)

                if kind=='store':

                         and len(parsed.get('profiles',{}))<=128,'bounded_local_profile_dictionary')

            'rows':rows,'sourceIdentity':list(main['expected']),
            'captureScope':'two_fixed_primary_keys_only','nonprimaryRowsCaptured':False}

def installed_registry(inputs):

    def query(db,until):
        # A finite, named table and one fixed key. Physical column order is
        # retained explicitly, never compared against another SELECT ordering.

                               ('installed_plugin_index',)).fetchall()

             and len(schema_rows[0][0].encode())<=16384,'bounded_actual_registry_schema')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""New public-probe custody adapter using scoped Darwin numeric projection.

The original QA helper remains unchanged. WNOWAIT/direct-Popen retention,
TERM1/wait5/group3 and signal-before-double-observation control flow are
preserved. The schema explicitly replaces ps lstart with second/microsecond
birth fields; this source alone is not actual Darwin runtime qualification.
"""
import os, signal, time
from mac_darwin_owned_projection_r1 import NativeProjection, NativeProjectionRefused, PROJECTION_SCHEMA

_projection=None
class Refusal(RuntimeError): pass
def need(value,code):
    if not value:raise Refusal(code)

def require_waitid():
    need(all(hasattr(os, name) for name in ("waitid", "P_PID", "WEXITED", "WNOHANG", "WNOWAIT",
                                          "CLD_EXITED", "CLD_KILLED", "CLD_DUMPED")),
         "wnowait_required_no_child_started")
    need(signal.getsignal(signal.SIGCHLD) == signal.SIG_DFL,
         "direct_child_reaping_policy_changed")

def exit_observation(child):
    """This is an observation, never Popen.poll/wait/communicate."""
    need(child.returncode is None, "child_already_reaped_no_signal")
    event = os.waitid(os.P_PID, child.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT)
    if event is None:
        return None
    need(event.si_pid == child.pid and event.si_signo == signal.SIGCHLD
         and event.si_code in (os.CLD_EXITED, os.CLD_KILLED, os.CLD_DUMPED),
         "child_exit_identity_changed")
    # Darwin reports si_uid=0 even for an observed uid501 child. Actual UID is
    # bound independently by the native projection; si_uid never grants ownership here.
    return {"pid": event.si_pid, "signo": event.si_signo, "code": event.si_code, "status": event.si_status}

def stable(row):
    return {key: row[key] for key in ("pid", "ppid", "pgid", "uid", "birthSeconds", "birthMicroseconds")}

def bind_projection(api):
    global _projection
    need(_projection is None and type(api) is NativeProjection and api.self_qualified,
         "native_projection_once_actual_self_qualification")
    _projection=api

def native_rows(pid=None, *, pgid=None, seconds=4.0, until=None):
    need(_projection is not None and _projection.self_qualified,
         "native_projection_not_qualified")
    need(until is not None and type(seconds) in (int,float) and 0<seconds<=4.0,
         "native_projection_original_bound")
    remaining=until-time.monotonic()
    need(remaining>0,"original_stop_deadline_expired")
    end=min(until,time.monotonic()+seconds)
    need((pid is None)!=(pgid is None),"scoped_pid_or_pgid_required")
    try:
        rows=([_projection.pid_row(pid,until=end)] if pid is not None
              else _projection.group_rows(pgid,until=end))
    except NativeProjectionRefused as error:
        code=error.code
        if code=="original_projection_deadline_expired":
            code=("original_stop_deadline_expired" if time.monotonic()>=until
                  else "process_projection_deadline_expired")
        raise Refusal(code) from error
    need(time.monotonic()<end,"original_stop_deadline_expired")
    return rows

def capture_child(child, *, until):
    require_waitid()
    rows = native_rows(child.pid, until=until)
    need(len(rows) == 1, "owned_child_identity_missing")
    row = rows[0]
    need(row["ppid"] == os.getpid() and row["pgid"] == child.pid
         and row["uid"] == os.geteuid(), "owned_child_scope_mismatch")
    # Darwin keeps an unreaped zombie in the native arg=1 projection but getpgid/getsid return ESRCH.
    # Use the real live APIs only for a still-live child; otherwise independently
    # repeat WNOWAIT and retain native birth plus Popen direct-parent custody.
    event, live_sid = exit_observation(child), None
    if event is None and not row["isZombie"]:
        try:
            need(os.getpgid(child.pid) == child.pid and os.getsid(child.pid) == child.pid,
                 "owned_live_session_mismatch")
            live_sid = child.pid
        except ProcessLookupError:
            # A fast exit between the first native projection/waitid and a live API call is
            # not loss of Popen custody, nor proof that the group is empty.
            event = exit_observation(child)
            need(event is not None, "owned_live_api_failed_without_retained_exit")
    if event is not None or row["isZombie"]:
        event = exit_observation(child)
        fresh = native_rows(child.pid, until=until)
        need(event is not None and len(fresh) == 1 and stable(fresh[0]) == stable(row)
             and fresh[0]["isZombie"] and exit_observation(child) == event,
             "owned_exit_not_retained")
        row = fresh[0]
    return {"projection": stable(row), "projectionSchema": PROJECTION_SCHEMA,
            "sid_observed_while_live": live_sid,"captured_exit": event}

def verify_unreaped(child, owner, *, until=None):
    event = exit_observation(child)
    rows = native_rows(child.pid, until=until)
    need(len(rows) == 1 and stable(rows[0]) == owner["projection"]
         and rows[0]["ppid"] == os.getpid(), "owned_child_identity_changed_no_signal")
    if event is None and not rows[0]["isZombie"]:
        # Exact native PGID/birth plus direct Popen/WNOWAIT custody keeps the
        # originally observed session leader reserved. Do not race a normal
        # exit by consulting Darwin's zombie-unsupported getpgid/getsid here.
        need(owner["projection"]["pgid"] == child.pid, "owned_live_session_changed_no_signal")
    else:
        event = exit_observation(child)
        need(event is not None and rows[0]["isZombie"] and exit_observation(child) == event,
             "owned_zombie_identity_changed_no_signal")
    return event

def live_group(child, owner, *, until):
    need(time.monotonic() < until, "original_stop_deadline_expired")
    verify_unreaped(child, owner, until=until)
    rows = native_rows(pgid=child.pid, until=until)
    selected = [row for row in rows if row["pgid"] == child.pid and not row["isZombie"]]
    need(all(row["uid"] == os.geteuid() for row in selected), "owned_group_uid_changed_no_signal")
    need(time.monotonic() < until, "original_stop_deadline_expired")
    return [stable(row) for row in selected]

def observed_returncode(event):
    if event is None:return None
    return event['status'] if event['code']==os.CLD_EXITED else -event['status']

def stop_once_unreaped(child, owner):
    """Called once by the wrapper's protected ledger; never calls Popen.poll."""
    require_waitid()
    started=time.monotonic()
    receipt={'pid':child.pid,'pgid':child.pid,'stopAttempted':True,'signals':[],
             'directChildReaped':False,'ownedLiveGroupEmptyBeforeReap':False,
             'allGroupRowsEmptyAfterReap':False,'cleanupCaps':{'term':1,'wait':5,'group':3,'psMax':4},
             'postReapSignalSent':False,'custody':owner}
    try:
        need(child.returncode is None,'already_reaped_no_group_signal')
        term_until=time.monotonic()+1.0
        if owner is None:
            owner=capture_child(child,until=term_until)
            receipt['custody']=owner
        members=live_group(child,owner,until=term_until)
        receipt['initialLiveGroup']=members
        if members:
            verify_unreaped(child,owner,until=term_until)
            need(time.monotonic()<term_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM);receipt['signals'].append('SIGTERM')
            while time.monotonic()<term_until:
                try:
                    members=live_group(child,owner,until=term_until)
                    if not members:break
                except Refusal as error:
                    if str(error)!='original_stop_deadline_expired' or time.monotonic()<term_until:
                        raise
                    break
                time.sleep(min(0.02,max(0,term_until-time.monotonic())))
        wait_until=time.monotonic()+5.0
        members=live_group(child,owner,until=wait_until)
        if members:
            verify_unreaped(child,owner,until=wait_until)
            need(time.monotonic()<wait_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);receipt['signals'].append('SIGKILL')
        event=exit_observation(child)
        while event is None:
            verify_unreaped(child,owner,until=wait_until)
            need(time.monotonic()<wait_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
            time.sleep(min(0.02,max(0,wait_until-time.monotonic())))
            event=exit_observation(child)
        need(time.monotonic()<wait_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
        receipt['retainedExit']=event
        # The old post-exit group3 interval now precedes the first reap.
        # This retains actual Popen PID custody while other live members leave.
        group_until=time.monotonic()+3.0
        while True:
            members=live_group(child,owner,until=group_until)
            if not members and exit_observation(child)==event:break
            need(time.monotonic()<group_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
            time.sleep(min(0.02,max(0,group_until-time.monotonic())))
        receipt['ownedLiveGroupEmptyBeforeReap']=True
        need(time.monotonic()<group_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
        child.wait(timeout=group_until-time.monotonic())
        receipt['directChildReaped']=True
        receipt['exitCode']=child.returncode
        need(child.returncode==observed_returncode(event),'actual_reap_matches_retained_exit')
        # After the first reap, only observe. No signal or ownership claim is
        # derived from this now-reusable numeric PGID.
        while True:
            rows=[row for row in native_rows(pgid=child.pid,until=group_until) if row['pgid']==child.pid]
            receipt['remainingGroupRows']=rows
            if not rows:break
            need(time.monotonic()<group_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
            time.sleep(min(0.02,max(0,group_until-time.monotonic())))
        receipt['allGroupRowsEmptyAfterReap']=True
        need(time.monotonic()<group_until,'original_stop_deadline_expired')
        receipt['ok']=True
    except BaseException as error:
        receipt['ok']=False
        receipt['errorType']=type(error).__name__
        receipt['errorCode']=str(error) if isinstance(error,Refusal) else None
        receipt['directChildReaped']=child.returncode is not None
        receipt['exitCode']=child.returncode
        # No second signal sequence, no renewed deadline, no automatic retry.
    receipt['elapsedSeconds']=time.monotonic()-started
    receipt['outcomeUnknown']=not(receipt.get('ok') is True
       and receipt['directChildReaped'] and receipt['allGroupRowsEmptyAfterReap'])
    return receipt

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only outer-parent custody of one Node -> launcher -> native process chain.

No credential, application-file or network reads. The response pipe's write end
is retained exclusively by the outer parent; a shared run directory is not an
authority channel. Exact Apple public libproc declarations and proc_bsdinfo ABI:
  xnu/bsd/sys/proc_info.h Git blob 718a69fcf5340f547893ed8dc85908f253c1ce81
  xnu/libsyscall/wrappers/libproc/libproc.h 602e4fe897d1fc5a7ceacc372c78f184ea242bfe
  xnu/libsyscall/wrappers/libproc/libproc.c c3e7369f886fbb7bbc8d77f8fca9ecc943bb5f4e
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import select
import sys
import time


from mac_owned_unreaped_r1 import exit_observation as retained_exit_observation

class ObservationRefused(RuntimeError):
    pass


def require(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise ObservationRefused(code)


class BsdInfo(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [(name, ctypes.c_uint32) for name in (
        'flags', 'status', 'xstatus', 'pid', 'ppid', 'uid', 'gid',
        'ruid', 'rgid', 'svuid', 'svgid', 'reserved',
    )] + [
        ('comm', ctypes.c_char * 16), ('name', ctypes.c_char * 32),
        ('nfiles', ctypes.c_uint32), ('pgid', ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('jobc', ctypes.c_uint32), ('ttydev', ctypes.c_uint32),
        ('tty_pgid', ctypes.c_uint32), ('nice', ctypes.c_int32),
        ('birth_sec', ctypes.c_uint64), ('birth_usec', ctypes.c_uint64),
    ]


class ProcessReader:
    def __init__(self):
        require(sys.platform == 'darwin' and ctypes.sizeof(BsdInfo) == 136,
                'exact_darwin_process_abi')
        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib', use_errno=True)
        self.lib.proc_pidinfo.argtypes = [
            ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint64,
            ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int,
        ]
        self.lib.proc_pidinfo.restype = ctypes.c_int
        self.lib.proc_pidpath.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint32]
        self.lib.proc_pidpath.restype = ctypes.c_int
        self.lib.proc_listchildpids.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
        self.lib.proc_listchildpids.restype = ctypes.c_int

    def read(self, pid):
        require(type(pid) is int and pid > 1, 'exact_pid_required')
        info = BsdInfo()
        count = self.lib.proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.sizeof(info))
        require(count == ctypes.sizeof(info) and info.pid == pid, 'process_info_complete')
        executable = ctypes.create_string_buffer(4096)
        length = self.lib.proc_pidpath(pid, executable, len(executable))
        require(0 < length < len(executable), 'process_path_complete')
        actual_path = executable.value.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        require(actual_path.startswith('/'), 'absolute_process_path')
        # A second birth read binds path lookup to the same process lifetime.
        again = BsdInfo()
        count = self.lib.proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, ctypes.byref(again), ctypes.sizeof(again))
        require(count == ctypes.sizeof(again)
                and (again.pid, again.ppid, again.pgid, again.uid,
                     again.birth_sec, again.birth_usec)
                == (info.pid, info.ppid, info.pgid, info.uid,
                    info.birth_sec, info.birth_usec), 'process_identity_changed_during_read')
        return {
            'pid': pid, 'ppid': info.ppid, 'pgid': info.pgid, 'uid': info.uid,
            'birthSec': info.birth_sec, 'birthUsec': info.birth_usec,
            'executable': str(Path(actual_path).resolve()),
        }

    def children(self, verified_pid):
        # proc_listchildpids returns a PID count, not bytes. The fixed bound is
        # fail-closed; it is not a process-wide command/argument enumeration.
        buffer = (ctypes.c_int * 32)()
        count = self.lib.proc_listchildpids(verified_pid, buffer, ctypes.sizeof(buffer))
        require(0 <= count < len(buffer), 'bounded_owned_child_list')
        return [int(buffer[i]) for i in range(count) if buffer[i] > 1]


def stable_identity(first, second):
    return first == second


class OwnedNativeObserver:
    def __init__(self, expected, *, critical):
        require(callable(critical), 'observer_fd_signal_guard_required')
        self.critical = critical
        self.fd_closures = {}
        self.expected = {

            'nativeExecutable': str(Path(expected['nativeExecutable']).resolve()),

        self.child_fds = ()

            'applicationFilesRead': False, 'networkUsed': False,
            'otherProcessArgumentsRead': False, 'requests': 0,

            with self.critical():
                self.request_read, request_write = os.pipe()
                for fd in (self.request_read, request_write):
                    self.fd_closures[fd] = {'fd': fd, 'attempted': False, 'closed': False, 'errorType': None}
                response_read, self.response_write = os.pipe()
                for fd in (response_read, self.response_write):
                    self.fd_closures[fd] = {'fd': fd, 'attempted': False, 'closed': False, 'errorType': None}
                self.child_fds = (request_write, response_read)

                'HEPTABAO_NATIVE_OBSERVER_REQUEST_FD': str(request_write),
                'HEPTABAO_NATIVE_OBSERVER_RESPONSE_FD': str(response_read),

            os.set_blocking(self.response_write, False)
            self.buffer = bytearray()
            self.handled = False
            self.rejected = False
        except BaseException:

            raise

    def close_fd_once(self, fd):
        require(fd in self.fd_closures, 'unknown_observer_fd_no_close')
        row = self.fd_closures[fd]
        if row['attempted']:
            return row['closed']
        with self.critical():
            row['attempted'] = True
            try:
                os.close(fd)

            except OSError as error:
                row['errorType'] = type(error).__name__
        return row['closed']

    def parent_after_spawn(self, proc):
        closed = [self.close_fd_once(fd) for fd in self.child_fds]
        self.child_ends_closed = all(closed)
        require(self.child_ends_closed, 'observer_child_end_close_unconfirmed')
        self.proc = proc
        self.outer_pid = os.getpid()

    def verify_chain(self, request, deadline):
        require(set(request) == {'schema', 'nonce', 'nodePid', 'launcherPid'},
                'observer_request_shape')
        require(request['schema'] == 'heptabao.owned-native-request.v1'
                and isinstance(request['nonce'], str)
                and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', request['nonce']) is not None,
                'observer_request_nonce')
        require(type(request['nodePid']) is int and request['nodePid'] == self.proc.pid
                and type(request['launcherPid']) is int
                and request['launcherPid'] > 1, 'observer_owned_request_pids')
        node_pid, launcher_pid = self.proc.pid, request['launcherPid']
        node = self.reader.read(node_pid)
        require(retained_exit_observation(self.proc) is None and node['ppid'] == self.outer_pid
                and node['pgid'] == node_pid and node['uid'] == os.geteuid()
                and node['executable'] == self.expected['nodeExecutable'],
                'owned_node_birth_parent_group_executable')
        pinned_launcher = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            require(retained_exit_observation(self.proc) is None and stable_identity(node, self.reader.read(node_pid)),
                    'owned_node_lifetime_changed')
            launcher = self.reader.read(launcher_pid)
            require(launcher['ppid'] == node_pid and launcher['pgid'] == node_pid
                    and launcher['uid'] == node['uid']
                    and (launcher['birthSec'], launcher['birthUsec'])
                    >= (node['birthSec'], node['birthUsec']),
                    'launcher_real_parent_group_birth')
            # /usr/bin/env may briefly precede the pinned shebang Node runtime.
            # No ACK is issued until the exact managed Node launcher is live.
            if launcher['executable'] != self.expected['nodeExecutable']:
                time.sleep(0.025)
                continue
            if pinned_launcher is None:
                pinned_launcher = launcher
            require(stable_identity(pinned_launcher, launcher), 'launcher_lifetime_changed')
            native_candidates = []
            for pid in self.reader.children(launcher_pid):
                try:
                    child = self.reader.read(pid)
                except ObservationRefused:
                    continue
                if child['executable'] == self.expected['nativeExecutable']:
                    native_candidates.append(child)
            require(len(native_candidates) <= 1, 'single_exact_native_child')
            if not native_candidates:
                time.sleep(0.025)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Finite owned launchd control for the isolated five-agent Mac candidate.

Library only, source-only. Launchd owns wrappers; wrappers own their actual
Popen children. This manager never claims those children are its direct children
and never sends a signal to a numeric PID or process group. Unknown state stops
the operation graph. Failed cleanup cannot become a successful generation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, hashlib, json, os, plistlib, re, stat, time
from pathlib import Path
from mac_native_process_observer_r1 import ProcessReader

ROOT=Path('/Volumes/T5/hepta-vnext-recovery-20261013/mac-authbus-4e808-current-registry-wal-r1')
QA=ROOT/'qa'
BINDING_READY=True  # Actual normal61 pins are bound; host execution requires separate root GO.
DOMAIN='gui/501'
LABELS={'server':'org.heptabao.qa.mac-authbus-4e808-wal-r1.server',
        'consumer':'org.heptabao.qa.mac-authbus-4e808-wal-r1.consumer'}
SERVER=Path('/Volumes/T5/hepta-vnext-recovery-20261013/continuation-20261105-same-root-publication-normal-r2/normal-release-tests-r1/artifacts/heptabao-server')
SERVER_SHA='c1b005a9f73c3f28681613d6fa3a5703d74e4f30358da4b7d9fa1949eb25ae63'
GRAPH=(('server-start','server-initial'),('phase','initial'),
       ('server-kill','server-initial'),('server-start','server-cold-new-process'),
       ('phase','cold-new-process'),('server-kill','server-cold-new-process'),
       ('phase','initial-inverse'),('phase','cold-new-process-inverse'))
AGENTS=('main','trnm','hepta-ui','hepta','hepta-backend')
NEW_MANAGER_SECONDS=600.0
NEW_CLEANUP_SECONDS=60.0
NEW_WRAPPER_READY_SECONDS=30.0
NEW_EXEC_OBSERVATION_SECONDS=10.0
NEW_FAILURE_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS=20.0
MAX_COMMANDS=4096
NEW_MANAGER_POLL_SECONDS=0.25
QUERY_SECONDS=10.0
PS_SECONDS=4.0

class ManagerRefused(RuntimeError):pass
def need(value,code):
    if not value:raise ManagerRefused(code)
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def encoded(value):return (json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
def file_identity(s):
    return tuple(str(x) for x in (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_mode,
        s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns))

def parse_print(raw,target):
    need(isinstance(raw,bytes) and len(raw)<=262144,'bounded_launchctl_print')
    lines=raw.decode('utf-8','strict').splitlines()
    need(1<=len(lines)<=4096 and lines[0].strip()==target+' = {','exact_launchctl_target')
    fields={};arguments=[];depth=1;in_arguments=False;arguments_seen=False
    allowed=('path','program','pid','state','runs','last exit code','last terminating signal')
    for line in lines[1:]:
        text=line.strip()
        if in_arguments:
            if text=='}':
                in_arguments=False;depth-=1;continue
            need(depth==2 and text and '{' not in text and '}' not in text
                 and len(text)<=16384,'plain_fixed_launchctl_argument')
            arguments.append(text)
            need(len(arguments)<=32,'bounded_launchctl_arguments')
            continue
        if depth==1 and text=='arguments = {':
            need(not arguments_seen,'one_launchctl_arguments_block')
            arguments_seen=True;in_arguments=True;depth+=1;continue
        if depth==1 and ' = ' in text and not text.endswith('{'):
            name,value=text.split(' = ',1)
            if name in allowed:
                need(name not in fields,'unique_launchctl_field');fields[name]=value
        depth+=text.count('{')-text.count('}')
        need(depth>=0,'balanced_launchctl_print')
        if depth==0:
            need(text=='}' and line==lines[-1],'one_complete_launchctl_record')
    need(depth==0 and not in_arguments and arguments_seen,'complete_launchctl_arguments')
    for name in ('pid','runs','last exit code'):
        if name in fields:
            need(re.fullmatch(r'-?[0-9]{1,10}',fields[name]) is not None,'typed_launchctl_integer')
            fields[name]=int(fields[name])
    need('pid' not in fields or fields['pid']>1,'actual_launchctl_pid')
    fields['arguments']=arguments
    return fields

def missing_service(code,out,err,label):
    if code not in (3,113) or out:return False
    try:lines=err.decode('utf-8','strict').splitlines()
    except UnicodeError:return False
    exact='Could not find service "'+label+'" in domain for user gui: 501'
    return lines in ([exact],['Bad request.',exact])

class OwnedLaunchd:
    def __init__(self,*,guard,commands,signals,until,anchor_raw,anchor_sha256,qa_pins,python_runtime):
        need(BINDING_READY is True,'mac_normal61_binding_not_admitted')
        now=time.monotonic()
        need(now<until<=now+NEW_MANAGER_SECONDS,'one_new_manager_deadline')
        need(guard.uuid_verified and not guard.closed,'held_t5_before_manager')
        need(isinstance(anchor_raw,bytes) and sha(anchor_raw)==anchor_sha256,'exact_public_anchor')
        need(isinstance(qa_pins,dict) and all(isinstance(k,str) and isinstance(v,str)
             and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',v) for k,v in qa_pins.items()),'typed_qa_pins')
        self.guard=guard;self.commands=commands;self.signals=signals;self.until=until
        self.started=now;self.anchor_raw=anchor_raw;self.anchor_sha=anchor_sha256
        self.qa_pins=dict(qa_pins);self.reader=ProcessReader()
        self.entries=[];self.graph_index=0;self.events=[];self.unknown=False
        self.failure_cleanup_attempted=False;self.cleanup_until=None
        self.command_count=0;self.finished=False;self.fd_rows=[]
        self._remaining()
        from mac_guarded_current_capture_r3 import public_code_pin
        actual_python=public_code_pin('/opt/homebrew/bin/python3',remaining=self._remaining,
                                      critical=self.signals.critical)
        need(actual_python==python_runtime,'same_actual_synthetic_python_for_wrappers')
        self.python_runtime=dict(actual_python)
        for kind in ('server','consumer'):
            need(self._query(LABELS[kind],None) is None,'owned_label_initially_absent')

    def _remaining(self,until=None,*,cleanup=False):
        if not cleanup:need(self.signals.pending is None,'manager_cancelled')
        bound=self.cleanup_until if cleanup else self.until
        need(bound is not None,'cleanup_deadline_exists')
        if until is not None:bound=min(bound,until)
        left=bound-time.monotonic();need(left>0,'original_manager_or_cleanup_deadline')
        return left

    def _call(self,label,argv,*,until=None,cleanup=False,ps=False):
        self._remaining(until,cleanup=cleanup)
        need(self.command_count<MAX_COMMANDS,'finite_manager_command_count')
        self.command_count+=1
        limit=PS_SECONDS if ps else QUERY_SECONDS
        bound=min(self.cleanup_until if cleanup else self.until,time.monotonic()+limit)
        if until is not None:bound=min(bound,until)
        row,out,err=self.commands.run(label,argv,until=bound,
                                      allow_cancelled_cleanup=cleanup,maximum=262144)
        if row['outcomeUnknown'] or not row['completeBeforeDeadline']:
            self.unknown=True
            raise ManagerRefused('owned_manager_command_unknown')
        self._remaining(until,cleanup=cleanup)
        return row,out,err

    def _query(self,label,entry,*,until=None,cleanup=False):
        need(label in LABELS.values(),'only_two_owned_labels')
        target=DOMAIN+'/'+label
        row,out,err=self._call('launchd-print',['/bin/launchctl','print',target],
                              until=until,cleanup=cleanup)
        if missing_service(row['exitCode'],out,err,label):return None
        need(row['exitCode']==0 and not err,'known_launchctl_query')
        value=parse_print(out,target)
        if entry is not None:
            need(value.get('path')==str(entry['plist'])
                 and value.get('program')==entry['arguments'][0]
                 and value['arguments']==entry['arguments'],'exact_registered_generation')
            need(value.get('runs') in (0,1),'one_launchd_run_only')
        return value

    def _record(self,kind,generation,detail):
        self._remaining()
        value={'schema':'heptabao.mac-owned-launchd-event.r3','index':len(self.events),
               'kind':kind,'generation':generation,'detail':detail}
        path=ROOT/'launchd'/('%03d-%s-%s.public.json'%(len(self.events),generation,kind))
        binding=self.guard.write_new(path,encoded(value))
        self.events.append({'kind':kind,'generation':generation,'path':str(path),**binding})

    def _expect_action(self,kind,generation):
        self._remaining()
        need(not self.finished and self.graph_index<len(GRAPH)
             and GRAPH[self.graph_index]==(kind,generation),'finite_launchd_operation_graph')
        need(not self.unknown,'no_business_after_unknown')

    def _advance(self):
        self._remaining();self.graph_index+=1

    def _plan(self,generation):
        path=ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.private.json')
        named_before=file_identity(path.lstat())
        raw=self.guard.read(path)
        need(named_before==file_identity(path.lstat()),'plan_identity_around_whole_read')
        value=json.loads(raw)
        need(isinstance(value,dict) and value.get('generation')==generation,'fixed_generation_plan')

    def _args(self,kind,path,plan_sha):
        common=['--plan',str(path),'--plan-sha256',plan_sha,
            '--public-volume-anchor-base64',base64.b64encode(self.anchor_raw).decode('ascii'),
            '--public-volume-anchor-sha256',self.anchor_sha]

            wrapper=QA/'mac_current_phase_owner_r2.py'
            common+=['--volume-guard-source-sha256',self.qa_pins['mac_t5_volume_guard_r1.py']]
        else:
            wrapper=QA/'mac_current_server_owner_r1.py'
            names=('mac_owned_unreaped_r1.py','mac_owned_commands_r1.py',
                   'mac_t5_volume_guard_r1.py','mac_native_process_observer_r1.py')
            raw=encoded({n:self.qa_pins[n] for n in names})
            common+=['--public-source-pins-base64',base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'),
                     '--public-source-pins-sha256',sha(raw)]

             'exact_wrapper_before_registration')

    def _new_entry(self,kind,generation):
        label=LABELS[kind]
        need(not any(e['label']==label and not e['registrationClosed'] for e in self.entries),
             'previous_owned_registration_closed')

        path,raw,plan=self._plan(generation)
        argv=self._args(kind,path,sha(raw))
        stdout=ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.stdout.private')
        stderr=ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.stderr.private')

            'AbandonProcessGroup':False,'ProcessType':'Background','ExitTimeOut':10,'Umask':0o077,
            'WorkingDirectory':str(ROOT),'StandardOutPath':str(stdout),
            'StandardErrorPath':str(stderr),
            'EnvironmentVariables':{'PATH':'/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin',
                                    'LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C'}}
        self.guard.write_new(plist,plistlib.dumps(expected,fmt=plistlib.FMT_XML,sort_keys=True))
        named_before=file_identity(plist.lstat())
        actual=self.guard.read(plist)
        need(named_before==file_identity(plist.lstat()),'plist_identity_around_whole_read')
        need(plistlib.loads(actual)==expected,'exact_owned_plist_no_keepalive')

            'plan':path,'planSha256':sha(raw),'plist':plist,'plistSha256':sha(actual),
            'arguments':argv,'stdout':stdout,'stderr':stderr,'wrapperIdentity':None,
            'execIdentity':None,'groups':set(),'registrationClosed':False,
            'lineagesClosed':False,'completeKnownSuccess':False,'attempts':{},
            'planIdentity':file_identity(path.lstat()),'plistIdentity':file_identity(plist.lstat())}
        cleanup_plan={'schema':'heptabao.mac-owned-launchd-cleanup-intent.r3',
            'generation':generation,'label':label,'target':entry['target'],
            'termArgv':['/bin/launchctl','kill','SIGTERM',entry['target']],
            'killArgv':['/bin/launchctl','kill','SIGKILL',entry['target']],
            'bootoutArgv':['/bin/launchctl','bootout',entry['target']],
            'newCleanupSeconds':NEW_CLEANUP_SECONDS,'noNumericPidOrGroupSignals':True}
        self.guard.write_new(ROOT/'launchd'/(generation+'.cleanup-intent.public.json'),
                             encoded(cleanup_plan))
        self._record('bootstrap-intent',generation,{'planSha256':entry['planSha256'],
            'plistSha256':entry['plistSha256'],'argv':['/bin/launchctl','bootstrap',DOMAIN,str(plist)]})
        self.entries.append(entry)
        return entry

    def _dispatch_once(self,entry,operation,argv,*,until=None,cleanup=False):
        need(operation in ('bootstrap','term','kill','bootout'),'fixed_manager_operation')
        expected={'bootstrap':['/bin/launchctl','bootstrap',DOMAIN,str(entry['plist'])],
            'term':['/bin/launchctl','kill','SIGTERM',entry['target']],
            'kill':['/bin/launchctl','kill','SIGKILL',entry['target']],

                 and ready.get('generation')==entry['generation']
                 and ready.get('planSha256')==entry['planSha256'],'typed_wrapper_ready')

                 and state.get('pid')==identity['pid'] and state.get('runs')==1,

                                 encoded(admission))

            ['/bin/ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,pgid=,uid=,stat='],until=until,cleanup=cleanup,ps=True)
        need(row['exitCode']==0 and not err,'complete_group_observation')
        values=[]
        for line in out.decode('ascii','strict').splitlines():
            fields=line.split()
            need(len(fields)==5 and all(x.isdecimal() for x in fields[:4]),'typed_process_row')

        # no mutation, and no new business budget is granted.

        need(file_identity(entry['plan'].lstat())==entry['planIdentity']
             and file_identity(entry['plist'].lstat())==entry['plistIdentity'],
             'registration_input_identity_unchanged')

    def _bootout(self,entry,*,cleanup=False,until=None):
        self._check_registration_files(entry)
        state=self._query(entry['label'],entry,until=until,cleanup=cleanup)
        if state is None:
            need('bootout' in entry['attempts'],'no_unexplained_registration_disappearance')
        elif 'bootout' not in entry['attempts']:
            if not cleanup:
                need(state.get('pid') is None,'known_wrapper_exit_before_bootout')
                self._record('bootout-intent',entry['generation'],{'argv':['/bin/launchctl','bootout',entry['target']]})

                                until=until,cleanup=cleanup)

    def _server_stdout_prefix(self,entry):

        This proves only the first LF-terminated record, read twice through one
        held descriptor. It does not claim a whole stable live server log.
        """
        self._remaining()

            with self.signals.critical():
                fd=os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK,dir_fd=parent)
                row={'fd':fd,'closeAttempted':False,'closed':False}

                     and first.st_nlink==1 and stat.S_IMODE(first.st_mode)==0o600
                     and 0<first.st_size<=2*1024*1024,'server_stdout_private_bound')

                     and state.get('runs')==1,'same_launchd_pid_before_server_exec')

    if isinstance(error,sqlite3.Error):
        value=getattr(error,'sqlite_errorcode',None)
        if type(value) is int and 0<=value<=0x7fffffff:row['sqliteCode']=value
        name=getattr(error,'sqlite_errorname',None)
        if isinstance(name,str) and re.fullmatch(r'SQLITE_[A-Z0-9_]{1,80}',name):row['sqliteName']=name
    if isinstance(error,OSError) and type(error.errno) is int and 0<=error.errno<=4095:
        row['errno']=error.errno
    return row
